# physics.optics [[Back]](#toc)

### [180] [Foundry-Fabricated Silicon Nitride Grating Arrays with Uniform Power Distribution at Visible Wavelengths](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30387)
*Amged Alquliah,Xiaoxin Wang,Jifeng Liu,Anthony Rizzo*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一种用于大规模并行光分配的总线-抽头(bus-and-tap)网络架构，基于级联定向耦合器并独立设计各耦合区相互作用长度，在300 mm氮化硅代工工艺中实现46通道可见光栅发射器的均匀照明，530 nm下发光强度变异系数9.3%，带宽积分(550–650 nm)下8.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多路复用光学生物传感器的通道数与集成密度受限于向各传感位点分配光的光子网络；现有片上网络多面向相控阵与图像投影，其性能以总体辐射方向图而非各输出端局部强度来评价，难以满足并行传感对均匀/定制化局部照明分布的需求，且传统二叉树架构只能产生二值化的功率分配。

Method: 采用总线-抽头架构：波导总线上级联多个定向耦合器作为抽头，逐一设计每个耦合器的相互作用长度以按需设定抽头比，从而合成任意用户自定义的照明分布；设计46个可见光波段光栅发射器通道，间距40 μm，目标为均匀照明；在商用300 mm硅氮化物(SiN)代工工艺中流片并实验表征，以发光强度变异系数(CV)为指标，分别在530 nm单波长与550–650 nm带内积分条件下评估均匀性。

Result: 实验实现46通道可见光栅发射器阵列，40 μm间距下实现均匀照明；530 nm处发射强度变异系数为9.3%，550–650 nm带内积分照明下为8.8%，验证了总线-抽头网络在可见光波段的可扩展、高均匀度并行光分配能力。

Conclusion: 总线-抽头架构借助独立设计的级联定向耦合器突破了二叉树网络的二值分配限制，可在标准SiN代工平台上实现高密度、高均匀度的可见光并行投递，为传感、成像、神经接口及量子系统并行光寻址等应用提供可扩展的可见光分配方案。

Abstract: Multiplexed optical biosensors are widely deployed to read out many biological targets in parallel. However, their channel count and integration density are limited by the photonic network that delivers light to individual sensing sites. Existing on-chip networks have been largely developed for phased arrays and image projection, where performance is assessed through an aggregate radiation pattern rather than the local intensity at each output. In this Letter, we demonstrate a novel bus-and-tap network architecture for massively parallel multiplexed optical delivery. The network uses cascaded directional couplers with individually designed interaction lengths, allowing for arbitrary, user-defined illumination patterns not possible with conventional binary tree architectures. We experimentally validated our proposed architecture with 46 visible-wavelength grating emitter channels designed for uniform illumination at 40 $μ$m pitch in a commercial 300-mm silicon nitride foundry process, achieving an emitted-intensity coefficient of variation of 9.3% at 530 nm, and 8.8% under band-integrated illumination from 550 nm to 650 nm. These results provide a route to scalable visible-light delivery for sensing, imaging, neural interfaces, and parallel optical addressing in quantum systems.

</details>


### [181] [Black-Hole Ringdown from Photon-Sphere Modes in an Elastic Analogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30396)
*Jiaoqing Wang,Chenni Xu,Sophia Purow,Sébastien Guenneau,Patrick Sebbah*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 利用曲面金属薄壳构建弹性黑洞类比系统，在时域直接观测由光子球曲率诱导有效势束缚的准正模衰荡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准正模主导黑洞衰荡，但其物理起源与实验可及性仍受限，缺乏可时域直接探测的类比平台。

Method: 设计弯曲金属薄壳以模拟类Schwarzschild度规，脉冲激励后用时间域方法测量振动动力学；对薄壳弹性方程作约化得到光子球有效势，并预测局域模频率随角向阶数的依赖。

Result: 观测到清晰的衰荡响应，其模式为局域于光子球附近的弯曲振动；即使强烈抑制边界反射，这些模式仍存在，表明束缚由曲率诱导有效势而非腔体边界决定；频率随角向阶数的依赖关系与理论预测一致。

Conclusion: 该平台可通过时间衰减与频谱特征直接获取准正模，建立光子球动力学与衰荡的直接联系；并将曲率诱导俘获确立为开放系统中波局域与耗散的普适机制。

Abstract: Quasinormal modes (QNMs) govern the ringdown of black holes, yet their physical origin and experimental accessibility remain limited. Here we create an elastic analogue of a black hole using a curved metallic shell engineered to emulate a Schwarzschild-like metric, and directly probe its vibrational dynamics in the time domain. Following impulsive excitation, the elastic system exhibits a clear ringdown response, providing a tangible analogue of black-hole ringing. The underlying modes are flexural vibrations localized near the photon sphere. A reduction of the thin-shell elastic equations yields a photon-sphere effective potential and predicts the dependence of the localized-mode frequencies on azimuthal order. Crucially, they persist even when boundary reflections are strongly suppressed, demonstrating that their confinement is governed by a curvature-induced effective potential rather than by cavity boundaries. This platform enables direct access to quasinormal modes through both their temporal decay and spectral signatures, establishing a direct connection between photon-sphere dynamics and ringdown. More broadly, our results identify curvature-induced trapping as a general mechanism for wave localization and dissipation in open systems.

</details>


### [182] [Laser with $7\times10^{-18}$ stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30532)
*Ben Lewis,Zoey Z. Hu,Dahyeon Lee,Kyungtae Kim,William Warfield,Kai Zhou,Daniele Nicolodi,Thomas Legero,Uwe Sterr,Fritz Riehle,Jun Ye*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 基于21 cm低温硅腔实现创纪录频率稳定度的激光器：6 K下短稳达7×10⁻¹⁸、线宽2.5 mHz；16 K（硅热膨胀零点）下长稳更优，线宽2.9 mHz、漂移<4 μHz/s，并用于提升Sr光晶格钟性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为提升光钟性能，需要更低线宽与更高频率稳定度的本地振荡激光；关键在于同时抑制布朗热噪声（短稳）与热膨胀引起的长漂（长稳），而二者由腔体工作温度权衡决定。

Method: 采用21 cm长的低温单晶硅光学腔，在两种温度下运行：6 K用于最小化布朗热噪声以获得最佳短稳；16 K利用硅热膨胀零交叉点以获得最佳长稳。将该超稳激光用于Sr光晶格钟的Rabi与Ramsey询问，询问时间超过10 s。

Result: 6 K：2–50 s积分时间分数稳定度7×10⁻¹⁸，线宽2.5 mHz。16 K：热噪声略增使稳定度降至9×10⁻¹⁸，与预期温度标度一致，但长期性能改善，线宽2.9 mHz，长期漂移<4 μHz/s。应用于Sr光晶格钟后支持>10 s的Rabi与Ramsey询问。

Conclusion: 低温硅腔可在短稳与长稳之间通过选择工作温度进行优化，21 cm腔体已实现创纪录稳定度，并可直接提升先进Sr光晶格钟的探测性能。

Abstract: We report a laser with record frequency stability, based on a 21 cm cryogenic silicon cavity. For best short-term stability, the cavity operates at 6 K to minimize Brownian thermal noise and achieves a fractional stability of $7\times10^{-18}$ between 2 to 50 s of averaging time and 2.5 mHz linewidth. For best long-term stability the cavity operates at 16 K, where silicon has a zero-crossing of thermal expansion. Slightly increased thermal noise limits the performance to $9\times10^{-18}$, consistent with the expected temperature scaling, but the long-term performance is improved. The laser then has a linewidth of 2.9 mHz and long-term frequency drift less than 4 μHz s$^{-1}$. The laser is used to enhance the performance of a state-of-the-art Sr lattice clock, operating with Rabi and Ramsey interrogation times beyond 10 s.

</details>


### [183] [Efficient third-harmonic generation in high-Q tantalum pentoxide microcavities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30579)
*Xinke Xing,Yixuan Yang,Xinzhi Zheng,Renhong Gao,Li Deng,Jintian Lin,Ya Cheng*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 首次在高质量因子五氧化二钽（Ta2O5）微腔中实现高效三次谐波产生（THG）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微腔非线性谐波产生是片上短波长相干光源的潜在途径；Ta2O5 具有宽透明窗口（280–8000 nm）、大带隙抑制双光子吸收、可厚膜沉积以进行色散调控等优势，适合非线性光源，但缺乏高效 THG 验证。

Method: 制备表面光滑、负载 Q 值高达 2.67×10^6 的 Ta2O5 微腔；通过色散工程，在悬空微盘与单片微环中于通信波段连续激光泵浦下实现 THG；以光谱、可见光显微成像及转换效率随泵浦功率的近三次方依赖进行验证。

Result: 在悬空微盘和单片微环两类结构中均实现高效 THG，转换效率呈近立方功率依赖，与三阶非线性过程相符。

Conclusion: 该工作为芯片级 f-3f 频率梳自参考及下一代集成非线性光子学奠定基础。

Abstract: Nonlinear harmonic generation in microcavities offers a compelling route toward energy efficient on-chip short-wavelength coherent light sources, enabled by tight optical confinement within compact mode volumes and flexible dispersion engineering. Tantalum pentoxide (Ta2O5) photonic platforms are particularly promising for realizing such nonlinear processes: their broad transparency window (280-8000 nm) supports broadband operation, their large bandgap suppresses two-photon absorption, and their thick-film deposition capability enables dispersion management--features that can collectively enhance the performance of nonlinear light sources. Here, we demonstrate, to the best of our knowledge, the first efficient third-harmonic generation (THG) in high-Q Ta2O5 microcavities. These microcavities feature smooth surfaces and high loaded Q factors up to 2.67X10^6, thereby facilitating nonlinear interactions. Through dispersion engineering, efficient THG is realized in both suspended microdisks and monolithic microrings under telecom-band continuous-wave laser pumping, as confirmed by optical spectra, visible-light microscopy, and the near-cubic pump-power dependence of the conversion efficiency. This work lays a foundation for chip-scale f-3f self-referencing of frequency combs and next-generation integrated nonlinear photonics.

</details>


### [184] [All-photonic millimeter-wave and terahertz signal core at room and cryogenic temperatures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30857)
*Jiawen Liu,Chengli Wang,Aleksei Gaier,Tianyi Zhang,Gabriel Jülg,Yazan Lampert,André Garcia Primo,Alessandro Tomasino,Hua Li,Xin Ou,Ileana-Cristina Benea-Chelmus*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文报道了一种单片钽酸锂光子芯片（"信号核"），可在100 GHz–2.5 THz的离散频率上完成信号的产生、调制、路由与探测，且仅通过光纤接口实现片外连接。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 100 GHz以上的电子信号链受限于弱光源、噪声接收机和有损互连。光子方案虽可缓解，但现有实现仍依赖有损的片外电学或自由空间链路，难以满足低温或空间受限场景下的密集紧凑集成需求。

Method: 构建全单片钽酸锂（LiTaO₃）光子集成芯片：在单一芯片上集成高频功能模块，采用微共面带状线将各模块级联为端到端信号链；利用双向相干电光转换实现信号产生、探测及纳秒级幅度与相位调制；芯片对外仅使用光纤光学接口，并在稀释制冷机4 K环境下通过同一光纤链路运行。

Result: 实现单光子电光耦合速率 g₀/2π = 10 kHz；峰值驱动功率归一化光子通量转换效率为产生方向1.0%/mW、探测方向0.5%/mW；芯片在4 K低温下正常工作。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了面向毫米波至太赫兹系统的全光子平台，为受电互连损耗、热负载与占位面积制约的应用提供了一种通用架构。

Abstract: Millimeter-wave and terahertz technologies offer new opportunities for high-capacity communications, sensing, and quantum systems, but electronic signal chains above 100 GHz are limited by weak sources, noisy receivers, and lossy interconnects. Photonic approaches mitigate these constraints by enabling chip-scale high-frequency components, yet existing implementations generally retain lossy off-chip electrical or free-space links, hindering dense and compact integration for cryogenic or space-constrained settings. Here, we show a monolithic lithium tantalate photonic chip, termed a signal core, which generates, modulates, routes, and detects continuous-wave signals at discrete frequencies between 100 GHz and 2.5 THz. The architecture integrates high-frequency functional modules on chip and uses exclusively fiber-based optical interfaces. Bidirectional coherent electro-optic conversion enables signal generation, detection, and nanosecond-scale amplitude and phase modulation, while micro-coplanar striplines interconnect the modules into an end-to-end signal chain on a single chip. Our modules achieve single-photon electro-optic coupling rates of g_0/2π=10 kHz and peak drive-power-normalized photon-flux conversion efficiencies of 1.0%/mW for generation and 0.5%/mW for detection. It also operates at 4 K in a dilution refrigerator through the same fiber-only optical links. Together, these capabilities establish an all-photonic platform for millimeter-wave-to-terahertz systems and offer a broadly applicable architecture for applications constrained by electrical-interconnect loss, heat load, and footprint.

</details>


### [185] [Alignment-Free Optical Combining with Scalar-Message Expectation Propagation Detection for Distributed Multi-Aperture Coherent Reception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30600)
*Mingwen Zhu,Yiqun Zhang,Liyu Sun,Ming Liu,Changwei Wang,Jiayin Xue*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一种免对齐的分布式多孔径光接收机，仅用单一相干前端，利用大差分时延形成的稀疏长记忆ISI信道，通过标量消息期望传播（EP）恢复符号，性能优于等面积单孔径接收，且复杂度随信道跨度增长缓慢。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多孔径相干接收通常需要多个相干前端（数字合并）或合并前的分支间时延/相位对齐，硬件成本与同步复杂度高。作者希望以"免对齐+单相干前端"降低对相干前端数量和对齐精度的要求。

Method: 各孔径分支信号在光域直接合并，不做分支间时延或相位对齐；大差分时延使各抽头形成分离的"抽头簇"，构成稀疏、长记忆的ISI信道；采用标量消息期望传播（scalar-message EP）利用该稀疏性在因子图上进行符号检测。

Result: 仿真中BER低于等面积单孔径接收，且在测试的时延范围内无明显BER退化；最大差分时延从100.5增至200.5符号周期时，信道跨度近乎翻倍，而因子图边数仅增加约1.5%。代价是BER高于理想相干合并方案。

Conclusion: 该方案以适度BER损失换取更少的相干前端（相比数字合并）和免时延/相位对齐的光域合并，且检测复杂度对信道跨度扩展不敏感，具备实用价值。

Abstract: We propose an alignment-free distributed multi-aperture optical receiver with a single coherent front end, in which the differential delays between apertures are large. The branch signals are optically combined without inter-branch delay or phase alignment. Large differential delays produce separated tap clusters, forming a sparse ISI channel with long memory. Scalar-message expectation propagation exploits this sparsity to recover the transmitted symbols. Simulations show lower BER than equal-area single-aperture reception and no clear BER degradation over the tested delay spans. As the maximum differential delay increases from 100.5 to 200.5 symbol periods, the channel span nearly doubles, while the factor-graph edge count increases by only about 1.5\%. The trade-off is higher BER than ideal coherent combining schemes in exchange for fewer coherent front ends than digital combining and no inter-branch delay or phase alignment before optical combining.

</details>


### [186] [Nanopillar metasurfaces uniting high optical reflectivity with ultracoherent nanomechanics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31452)
*Alexander Jung,Anastasiia Ciers,Hannes Pfeifer,Albert Hansson,Johanna Örgård,Daniel Stachanow,Viktor A. Lilja,Philippe Tassin,Witlef Wieczorek*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 通过在薄膜上引入高折射率纳米柱超表面，同时实现高反射率与超高相干机械模式，消除了腔光力学中光学与机械性能的取舍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腔光力学中，高反射率需要厚反射镜，而超相干弯曲纳米力学需要薄膜，两者需求直接冲突，构成光学与机械性能的固有权衡。

Method: 在薄膜上图案化高折射率纳米柱超表面，形成直径50微米的光子晶体阵列；利用导模共振的平带行为实现反射，并通过两个导模共振组合构建高反射带，同时纳米柱图案化构成密度调制声子晶体以隔离局域机械模式。

Result: 对7微米腰斑的紧聚焦光束实现99.82(1)%反射率；在1550纳米附近形成100纳米宽的高反射带；隔离出Q·f乘积达2×10^14 Hz的超相干局域机械模式。

Conclusion: 该纳米柱超表面方案提供了轻量反射镜，可用于室温量子光力学，并可作为悬浮反射镜或光帆使用。

Abstract: Mechanically compliant mirrors are key components in cavity optomechanics. However, the requirements to achieve the best optical and mechanical performance are usually in direct competition. A high reflectivity for tightly focused beams entails thick reflectors, whereas ultracoherent flexural nanomechanics necessitates thin membranes. We eliminate this trade-off by introducing high-refractive-index nanopillar metasurfaces on top of a thin membrane. We pattern a 50 micrometer-diameter array of nanopillars to form a photonic crystal. The flat band behavior of guided resonances in the photonic crystal enables a reflectivity of 99.82(1)% for a tightly focused beam of 7 micrometer waist. The combination of two guided resonances creates a 100 nanometer-wide high-reflectivity band around 1550 nanometer. Simultaneously, the nanopillar patterning realizes a density-modulated phononic crystal that isolates an ultracoherent localized mechanical mode with a $Q\cdot f$-product of $2\cdot 10^{14}$Hz. The demonstrated nanopillar metasurfaces enable lightweight mirrors for room-temperature quantum optomechanics and for use as levitated mirrors or lightsails.

</details>


### [187] [Metasurface engineering of transient photothermal responses for vibrational imaging at living interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30610)
*Zhibin Hu,Tianrun Zhang,Jiayu Ding,Pengcheng Fu,Ziyang Huang,Bo Chen,Bangjie Song,Minglu Li,Xinyu Deng,Quan D. Zhou,Delong Zhang,Siying Peng*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出超表面驱动中红外光热成像（MetaMIP），借助共振超表面放大分子温度调制并保持快速热恢复，实现单个纳米颗粒与生物细胞的亚微米化学成像，并解析活细胞膜上酶促脂质转化的空间差异化学变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物界面上的化学转化对细胞功能至关重要，但微弱振动信号使空间分辨观测受限，需提升中红外光热信号灵敏度与空间分辨能力。

Method: MetaMIP：共振工程化超表面放大分子温度调制，同时保留快速热恢复；以可见光探测将光热响应转换为亚微米化学成像图。

Result: 获得单个纳米颗粒与生物细胞的亚微米化学分布图；在活细胞中分辨细胞膜上酶促脂质转化过程中空间上不同的化学变化。

Conclusion: 工程化光热界面可用于绘制化学组成并追踪反应过程中的演化，展示了超表面增强中红外光热成像在生物界面化学研究中的潜力。

Abstract: Chemical transformations at biological interfaces are central to cellular function, yet the weak vibrational signals associated with subtle molecular changes limit their spatially resolved observation. Here, we present metasurface-driven mid-infrared photothermal imaging (MetaMIP), which uses resonantly engineered metasurfaces to amplify molecular temperature modulation while retaining rapid thermal recovery. Visible-light detection converts this response into submicrometre maps of individual nanoparticles and biological cells. In living cells, MetaMIP resolves spatially distinct chemical changes during enzymatic lipid conversion across the cell membrane. These results demonstrate the potential of engineered photothermal interfaces for mapping chemical composition and tracking its evolution during reactions.

</details>


### [188] [Confinement of hybridized light modes in nonlinear-optical superpotentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31643)
*Federico Presutti,Ryotatsu Yanagimoto*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文提出由相干频率转换诱导的时空光囚禁机制：泵浦非线性在频域充当两信号模式间的分束器，反向传播时在非线性零点处产生本征囚禁模，并与超对称量子力学建立直接联系，可用于薄膜铌酸锂上的集成光子存储与量子非线性光子学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索主动光子存储/光囚禁的物理机制，寻找可供集成的、参数与当前集成非线性光子学工艺兼容的囚禁方案。

Method: 构造波混频过程（泵浦非线性介导的频域分束器相互作用），在反向传播情形下求解系统本征模；借助超对称量子力学证明囚禁模在非线性零点处的存在性与鲁棒性，并解析求解束缚本征模；进一步提出在薄膜铌酸锂上的原理性验证实验，并研究囚禁与参量增益的联合使用。

Result: 确立了时空囚禁与超对称量子力学的对应关系，给出囚禁本征模的存在性、鲁棒性及解析解；确认反向和频转换可用于主动光子存储；设计参数与先进集成非线性光子学兼容；提出薄膜铌酸锂上的验证实验，并展示囚禁与参量增益结合的案例。

Conclusion: 相干频率转换可产生受超对称结构保护的时空囚禁模，构成一类独特主动光子存储器件，潜在应用于经典集成光子学与多模量子非线性光子学。

Abstract: In this work, we present a spatial and temporal light trapping mechanism induced by coherent frequency conversion. We consider a wave-mixing process, where a pumped nonlinearity mediates a frequency-domain beamsplitter interaction between two signal modes. When these wave modes are counterpropagating, temporally trapped eigenmodes emerge at the zero of the nonlinearity profile. We establish that such spatio-temporal trapping has a direct connection to supersymmetric quantum mechanics, which ensures the existence and robustness of the trapped modes and allows us to derive analytic solutions of the bound eigenmodes. Backwards sum-frequency conversion may thus enable a unique class of active photonic memory devices, whose design parameters are compatible with the state of the art in integrated nonlinear photonics. We propose proof-of-principle experiments to study this nonlinear-optical trapping effect on thin-film lithium niobate. In addition, as a case study, we show how the temporal trap can be used alongside parametric gain. Our work unveils potential applications ranging from classical integrated photonics to multimode quantum nonlinear photonics.

</details>


### [189] [Reconfigurable Free-Space Optical Interconnects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30757)
*Jaekwon Lee,Carson G. Valdez,Anne R. Kroo,David A. B. Miller,Olav Solgaard*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出基于可重构微镜阵列的自由空间光互连系统，利用二维缩放优势，用活塞运动微镜阵列演示9通道同时优化，最坏情况串扰-21.7 dB，并外推万通道量级实现100 Tbps。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自由空间光互连可承载大量低速率通道，规避波导/光纤系统在成本、能耗与封装上的限制；需探讨其通道数缩放潜力及降低通道串扰的方案。

Method: 构建基于可重构微镜阵列的自由空间光互连架构，建立通道数二维缩放模型并与实验对比；在活塞运动微镜阵列的概念验证系统中对9个通道进行同时优化，并考察不同通道间距、同时照明与不同输出数下的优化流程，与平面tip-tilt反射镜方案比较。

Result: 9通道同时优化，在通道间距等于两倍光束半径时实现平均最坏情况串扰-21.7 dB，通道间距小于平面tip-tilt反射镜所需间距；多情形下最坏情况串扰普遍优于平面tip-tilt方案；理论上通道数可超10,000，以<10 Gbps慢通道实现100 Tbps。

Conclusion: 活塞运动微镜在所提出的光互连中具备串扰抑制与紧凑间距优势，二维缩放使其可扩展至万通道量级，适合大规模低速率通道互连场景。

Abstract: Free-space optical interconnects can support many low-data-rate channels while avoiding the cost, energy consumption, and packaging constraints of optical waveguide- or fiber-based systems that are widely used today. We propose a free-space optical interconnect system based on reconfigurable micromirror arrays, and show that it scales favorably due to its two-dimensional scaling. We discuss the channel count scaling model, compare our demonstration with theory, and project a channel count above 10,000 to achieve 100 Tbps with slow channels (e.g., <10 Gbps). In a proof-of-concept system with a piston-motion micromirror array, we demonstrate nine channels that are simultaneously optimized. The optimization enables -21.7 dB of average worst-case crosstalk for a channel pitch equal to twice the beam radius, a smaller channel spacing than that required in flat tip-tilt mirrors. The optimization flow is further investigated for different channel spacings, simultaneous illumination, and different numbers of outputs, which generally achieve smaller worst-case crosstalk than the flat tip-tilt mirror case. Overall, the work demonstrates the advantage of piston-motion micromirrors in the proposed optical interconnects.

</details>


### [190] [Light pulse propagation through a dielectric slab. II. Two roads to the same field: numerical cross-validation of local (FDTD-ADE) and non-local (retarded integral-equation) solutions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30833)
*Giancarlo Reali*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该报告绕过局域微分方程，直接数值求解Paper I导出的推迟积分方程，与FDTD-ADE解交叉验证，二者在极短脉冲与亚波长平板情形下吻合于0.02–1.3%，并与Airy精确参考一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Paper I已证明局域微分方程与推迟积分方程解析等价，但此前仅通过局域表述（FDTD-ADE）获得数值解。本文旨在闭合验证环路：不经过局域表述，直接求解积分方程，检验两种结构上独立实现的数值方案是否在真实含时（脉冲）区域互相印证，并给出吸收分数的独立计算。

Method: 在相同的物理与材料条件下，直接数值求解一对推迟积分方程（不借助局域形式），并与FDTD-ADE解对比反射、透射能量分数；吸收分数在两套方案中均直接由洛伦兹阻尼项独立计算，而非由1-R-T推断。进一步以脉冲谱加权后的Airy公式作为精确参考，并进行Richardson外推。另给出九帧电影式场可视化。

Result: 反射与透射能量分数在两套独立实现、结构不同的数值方案间吻合0.02–1.3%；由洛伦兹阻尼项独立算得的吸收分数亦高度一致。直接解与谱加权Airy精确参考偏差在0.3%以内，其Richardson外推在所示位数上完全吻合。该一致性在少周期脉冲与亚波长平板情形下依然成立，而后者中积分方程的朴素不动点迭代并非可行的收敛策略。

Conclusion: 直接求解推迟积分方程与FDTD-ADE两套方案的数值交叉验证成功，证实解析等价性在含时区域具有实际数值对应；据作者所知，此类对两种表述的真正含时直接数值交叉验证此前未见报道。

Abstract: Paper I of this series (arXiv:2610.29336) solves, via the retarded Green's functions, the local differential equations governing light propagation in a plane-parallel dielectric slab, obtaining a pair of retarded integral equations that represent, at the continuum level, the microscopic multiple-scattering picture underlying the local formulation. The two formulations are thus proven to be analytically equivalent. The local system of differential equations is then solved numerically with a finite-difference time-domain scheme (FDTD-ADE). This report closes the loop by solving the retarded integral equations directly, without passing through the local formulation, and comparing the result with the FDTD-ADE solution under the same physical and material conditions. The two independently implemented, structurally different numerical schemes agree within 0.02-1.3% for the reported reflected and transmitted energy fractions; the absorbed fraction, computed independently in both schemes from the Lorentz damping term rather than merely inferred from 1-R-T, agrees closely between the two methods, to the precision reported. Both solutions are also compared with an exact reference, the Airy formula weighted over the pulse spectrum: the direct solution reproduces it to within 0.3%, and its Richardson extrapolation to all digits shown. The agreement persists for a few-cycle pulse and for a sub-wavelength slab, where naive fixed-point iteration of the integral equations is not a practical convergent strategy. A complementary set of movie-style, nine-frame visualizations is also presented, illustrating the same equivalence directly in the field rather than only in integrated observables. To the author's knowledge, a direct numerical cross-validation of these two formulations in this genuinely time-dependent regime has not previously been reported.

</details>


### [191] [Laser-design methodology for extending an available wavelength range of dual-wavelength injection-seeded laser](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30897)
*Ayaka Hashimoto,Tetsuto Watanabe. Sota Kobayashi,Megumi Otose,Ken'ichi Nakagawa,Masayuki Katsuragawa*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文提出通过对输出耦合镜引入波长依赖特性来拓展双波长振荡注入锁定激光器的适用波长范围，实现增益中心与增益尾同时等功率振荡，最大波长间隔达60 nm。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双波长振荡注入锁定激光器在增益中心与增益尾同时振荡时对设计提出最严苛要求，需在不增加谐振腔损耗的前提下拓展其适用波长范围。

Method: 在输出耦合镜上引入波长依赖特性，避免腔内额外损耗；并给出基于实验测量确定该波长依赖特性的方法，据此设计输出耦合器。

Result: 采用所设计输出耦合器，在增益中心附近与增益尾附近的多组波长组合下实现等输出功率的同时振荡，最大波长间隔60 nm。

Conclusion: 通过在输出耦合镜引入波长依赖特性，可在不增加谐振腔损耗的情况下有效拓展双波长振荡注入锁定激光器的波长范围。

Abstract: This paper describes a method for expanding the applicable wavelength range of dual-wavelength oscillation injection-locked lasers. Special focus is placed on the laser design that enables simultaneous oscillations at both the gain center and gain tail, requiring the most stringent requirements. We show that a sufficient performance can be achieved by introducing a wavelength-dependence property onto the output coupling mirror, without giving any losses in the laser resonator. We also show how we can determine such wavelength-dependent property on the basis of experimental measurements. Using the designed output-coupler, in practices, we demonstrate simultaneous oscillations with an equal output power, across a variety of wavelength combinations of near the gain center and around the gain tail in which the wavelength separation amounts 60 nm at the most.

</details>


### [192] [Intrinsic Angular Momentum Contribution to the Sagnac Response of a Rotating Helical Optical Fiber](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30898)
*Lili Yang,Pengming Zhang,Longlong Feng*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 利用四分量类狄拉克方程研究结构化光在机械旋转均匀螺旋光纤中的旋转致相位累积，发现在共路镜面反射几何中，扭转几何相位与面积相关的Sagnac项在完整往返中相互抵消，而内禀的旋转—角动量相位保留，可用于探测内禀角动量效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究结构化光在机械旋转螺旋光纤中的旋转致相位累积机制，区分不同来源的相位贡献（扭转几何相位、Sagnac相位、旋转—角动量耦合相位），并寻找能在旋转传感中分离内禀角动量效应的共路干涉方案。

Method: 在近轴、弱几何条件下，采用四分量类狄拉克方程描述均匀螺旋光纤中的光传播，将内禀动力学分解为扭转诱导的几何耦合与机械旋转—角动量耦合；分析共路镜面反射几何下完整往返过程中各项相位的累积与抵消情况。

Result: 在共路镜面反射几何中，扭转诱导的几何相位与常规的面积相关Sagnac贡献在完整往返中均相互抵消，而内禀的旋转—角动量相位得以保留；该剩余相位依赖于结构化光模式的内禀总角动量。

Conclusion: 该保留的旋转—角动量相位为在旋转传感中探测内禀角动量效应提供了一条共路干涉测量途径。

Abstract: We investigate rotation-induced phase accumulation of structured light in a mechanically rotating uniform helical optical fiber using a four-component optical Dirac-like equation. In the paraxial and weak-geometry regime, the intrinsic dynamics contain a torsion-induced geometric coupling and a mechanical rotation--angular-momentum coupling. We show that, in a common-path mirror-reflection geometry, both the torsion-induced geometric phase and the conventional area-dependent Sagnac contribution cancel over a complete round trip, whereas the intrinsic rotation--angular-momentum phase survives. The surviving phase depends on the intrinsic total angular momentum of the structured optical mode and provides a common-path interferometric route for probing intrinsic angular momentum effects in rotational sensing.

</details>


### [193] [Efficient Modeling of 3D-Printed Freeform Waveguides with a Transformation Optics-Based Beam Propagation Method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31004)
*Sina Foroutan-Barenji,Jonas Krimmer,Stefan Singer,Christian Koos,Wolfgang Freude*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出将变换光学(TO)与曲线网格结合、并采用各向异性全矢量BPM的TO-BPM方法，用于高效仿真3D打印自由曲面光子引线键合(PWB)中的波传播，相比FDTD仿真时间缩短两个数量级以上，功率传输的MAPE为3.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D打印自由曲面光子引线键合(PWB)结构复杂、轨迹弯曲，直接对其进行全波仿真（如FDTD）计算代价极高，需要一种高效且精度可接受的数值方法。

Method: 把变换光学(TO)与曲线网格(curvilinear meshing)相结合，将原始三维自由曲面PWB结构映射为具有各向异性材料特性的直波导，再对该直波导使用各向异性全矢量束传播法(BPM)进行分析；并与FDTD结果进行对比验证。

Result: 与FDTD相比，所提TO-BPM算法将仿真时间缩短两个数量级以上（缩短程度取决于轨迹弯曲程度），同时功率传输仿真的平均绝对百分比误差(MAPE)为3.9%。

Conclusion: TO-BPM在保持较低误差（MAPE 3.9%）的前提下显著提升PWB波传播仿真的效率，是一种可行且高效的替代FDTD的仿真方案。

Abstract: An efficient numerical method is introduced for simulating wave propagation in 3D-printed freeform waveguides, referred to as photonic wire bonds (PWBs). This approach integrates transformation optics (TO) with curvilinear meshing to map the original 3D freeform PWB structure onto a straight waveguide, which possesses anisotropic material characteristics. The resulting waveguide is then analyzed using an anisotropic full-vectorial beam propagation method (BPM). To validate the performance and effectiveness of the proposed TO-BPM algorithm, a comparison is made with the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) technique. Our approach reduces the simulation time by more than two orders of magnitude, depending on the degree of trajectory bending, in combination with a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 3.9% in power transmission simulation relative to the FDTD.

</details>


### [194] [Effective-action formulation of $\mathbf{k}$-odd bianisotropy and unidirectional polarization rotation in nonlocal temporal metamaterials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31022)
*Neng Wang,Guo Ping Wang*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 通过对电磁拉格朗日密度的多尺度分析，导出时间超材料至空间导数一阶的有效作用量，揭示一阶空间修正产生对波矢k为奇的双各向异性耦合张量，并据此建立基于有效作用量Hessian的洛伦兹互易性判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间超材料（时变介质）的非局域电磁响应缺乏系统的有效理论描述，尤其是一阶空间导数修正的物理含义及其与手性、伪手性、omega型双各向异性响应的关系，以及与洛伦兹互易性破缺的联系尚不清晰。

Method: 对电磁拉格朗日密度进行多尺度（空间导数展开）分析，将有效作用量展开至空间导数一阶；提取一阶修正对应的有效双各向异性耦合张量，并用有效作用量的Hessian构建洛伦兹互易性分析框架。

Result: 一阶空间修正给出一个对波矢k为奇的双各向异性耦合张量；手性、伪手性与omega型双各向异性响应是该单一非局域耦合张量的不同方向表现，即使基础电、磁响应张量保持对称。基于Hessian的判据表明：omega型耦合下洛伦兹互易性保持，而手性或伪手性耦合出现时互易性破缺，表现为Floquet工程手性与伪手性引起的归一化Stokes矢量的单向旋转。

Conclusion: 时间超材料的非局域双各向异性可统一由单一奇宇称（k-odd）耦合张量描述，各类手性响应仅为方向性表现；有效作用量Hessian为判断洛伦兹互易性提供了统一框架，非互易性可由Stokes矢量的单向旋转表征。

Abstract: We derive the effective action of temporal metamaterials up to first order in spatial derivatives through a multiscale analysis of the electromagnetic Lagrangian density. We show that the first-order spatial correction gives rise to an effective bianisotropic coupling tensor that is odd in the wavevector $\mathbf{k}$. Remarkably, chiral, pseudochiral, and omega-type bianisotropic responses emerge as distinct directional manifestations of a single nonlocal coupling tensor, even when the underlying electric and magnetic response tensors remain symmetric. Furthermore, we establish a framework for analyzing Lorentz reciprocity based on the Hessian of the effective action. We demonstrate that Lorentz reciprocity is preserved in the presence of omega-type coupling but is broken when chiral or pseudochiral coupling emerges. This nonreciprocity manifests as the unidirectional rotations of normalized Stokes vectors incurred by Floquet-engineered chirality and pseudochirality.

</details>


### [195] [The Mechanism of Chirality in Plasmonic Structures: Asymmetric Resonance Modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31045)
*Abduweli Abdukerim*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文提出一个理论框架，通过定量分析非对称等离激元共振模式引起的非对称电场分量，解释手性纳米结构中手性产生与圆二色性（CD）的机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有研究虽将手性光学性质与共振差异联系起来，但这些差异的具体本质与起源尚未被充分阐明，需要一个更细致的机制解释。

Method: 定量分析模式非对称性产生的非对称电场分量；考察单个纳米棒及角堆叠耦合结构（CSCS）的近场对称性，比较RCP与LCP光照下电磁场的相位与振幅响应。

Result: 手性源于非对称电场分布，导致复合结构在RCP/LCP下呈现不同的相位与振幅响应；吸收与CD谱在910 nm附近呈现明显特征，支持该机制。

Conclusion: 该机制不局限于特定手性结构或共振，为圆二色性的产生提供了更普适的解释，并对手性光学材料设计具有指导意义。

Abstract: This study presents a theoretical framework for understanding the mechanism of chirality generation and circular dichroism (CD) in chiral nanostructures, with a particular focus on the role of asymmetric plasmon resonance mode distributions. Although previous studies have linked chiroptical properties to resonance differences, the specific nature and origin of these differences have not been fully elucidated. Here, we provide a more detailed explanation by quantitatively analyzing the asymmetric electric-field components arising from mode asymmetry. Specifically, we examine the near-field symmetry of individual nanorods and corner-stacked coupled structures (CSCS). The results demonstrate that chirality arises from asymmetric electric-field distributions, which give rise to distinct phase and amplitude responses of the electromagnetic fields in the composite structure under right-handed circularly polarized (RCP) and left-handed circularly polarized (LCP) illumination. The absorption and CD spectra, which exhibit distinct features around $910\,\mathrm{nm}$, support this mechanism and provide valuable insights into the design of chiroptical materials. The proposed mechanism is not restricted to a specific chiral structure or resonance and offers a broader explanation for the generation of circular dichroism.

</details>


### [196] [Shaping Near Fields of Photonic Modes into Topological Textures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31207)
*Jonas Biechteler,Michael Hirler,Connor Heimig,Martin Barkey,Haoran Ren,Stefan A. Maier,Enrico Baù,Andreas Tittl*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文提出利用支撑准连续域束缚态（quasi-BIC）共振的介质超表面进行几何工程，在近场无需极化激元表面波即可生成可控拓扑荷的光学拓扑织构，并通过相位分辨s-SNOM实验验证了高纯度、共振锁定的涡旋与拓扑荷双重态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近场光学拓扑（涡旋、斯格明子）对高密度信息编码和光-物质相互作用有吸引力，但现有实现主要依赖极化激元平台，其拓扑与材料色散绑定，受传播损耗限制 footprints，并限定了工作光谱范围。作者希望摆脱极化激元表面波依赖，实现频谱与空间可扩展的近场拓扑生成。

Method: 设计硅介质超表面，利用准BIC共振；对超表面条带进行面内形变，使共振驱动的近场局部守恒，从而由几何构型与照明光偏振共同决定拓扑；将硅单胞塑造成具有旋转对称性的几何结构以调控拓扑荷；采用相位分辨散射型近场光学显微镜（s-SNOM）进行实验表征。

Result: 实验观测到高纯度、共振锁定的拓扑结构，包括同心环中的涡旋以及阿基米德螺旋中的拓扑荷双重态，且拓扑荷可控。

Conclusion: 所生成的场织构为纯光子模式基，径向为驻波，不依赖表面波传播或极化激元色散，构建了光谱与空间可扩展的近场拓扑光子学平台。

Abstract: Topological textures of light, such as optical vortices and skyrmions, are attractive for high-density information encoding and light-matter interactions. In the near field, topologies have primarily been realized using polaritonic platforms that inherently tie the platform to the material dispersion, limiting their footprint due to propagation losses and restricting their operating spectral region. Here, we introduce a route to shape near-field topologies through the geometric engineering of a dielectric metasurface supporting a quasi-bound state in the continuum resonance, without the need for polaritonic surface waves. In-plane deformation of our metasurface bars conserves their resonance-driven near-fields locally, so that the metasurface geometry and the polarization of the illuminating light dictate the generated topology. By shaping silicon unit cells into geometries with rotational symmetry, we create optical topologies with controllable topological charge. Using phase-resolved scattering-type near-field optical microscopy, we experimentally characterize high-purity resonance-locked topologies such as vortices in concentric rings and topological charge doublets in Archimedean spirals. In contrast to conventional topological textures, our purely photonic mode-based field textures are stationary standing waves in the radial direction, without relying on surface-wave propagation or polaritonic dispersion, establishing a spectrally and spatially scalable platform for near-field topological photonics.

</details>


### [197] [Second- and third-order nonlinearities in silicon nitride waveguides via heterogeneous integration of lithium niobate membranes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31243)
*Natale G. Pruiti,Cosmin Suciu,Eugenio Di Gaetano,Jonathan M. Silver,Douglas J. Paul,Marc Sorel*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 通过在成品氮化硅波导上后端键合x切薄膜铌酸锂膜，单一波导同时实现倍频程超连续谱与二阶非线性过程，为厚氮化硅光子学提供二阶非线性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 厚且色散工程化的氮化硅是集成三阶非线性光学（超连续谱、频率梳）的主流平台，但缺乏二阶非线性，限制了可见光产生与f-2f自参考等应用。

Method: 将预制x切薄膜铌酸锂膜键合到已完成的氮化硅波导上作为后端工艺，兼容商用制备波导；在单一波导中激发倍频程超连续谱，并经铌酸锂膜同时实现二次谐波、和频与差频产生。

Result: 单一氮化硅波导产生倍频程超连续谱，并借助铌酸锂膜同时实现二次谐波、和频与差频产生。

Conclusion: 该异质集成方案为厚氮化硅光子学开辟新路径，从可见光产生到片上f-2f梳自参考，是迈向小型化授时与导航量子技术的关键一步。

Abstract: Thick, dispersion-engineered silicon nitride is a leading platform for integrated third-order nonlinear optics, supporting supercontinuum and frequency comb generation. However, it lacks the second-order nonlinearity required by many applications. Here we bond pre-fabricated x-cut thin-film lithium niobate membranes onto finished silicon nitride waveguides as a back-end step, compatible with commercially fabricated waveguides. A single silicon nitride waveguide generates an octave-spanning supercontinuum and, through the lithium niobate membrane, concurrent second-harmonic, sum- and difference-frequency generation. These results open new possibilities for thick silicon nitride photonics, from visible light generation to on-chip $f$-$2f$ comb self-referencing, a key step towards miniaturised timing and navigation quantum technologies.

</details>


### [198] [A New Twist on Astigmatic Transformation: Beyond Laguerre-Gaussian Beams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31313)
*Gabriela Flores-Cova,Bikash Kumar Das,Carmelo Rosales-Guzman,Valeria-Rodriguez-Fajardo,Camilo Granados*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文证明像散变换的相位-强度转换不限于拉盖尔-高斯径向分布，可推广为标量结构光场拓扑荷的直接探测手段，并借助偏振分辨检测独立确定不可分矢量贝塞尔-高斯光束中各空间模式的拓扑荷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 像散变换广泛用于将拉盖尔-高斯涡旋光束的方位相位结构转换为可读出拓扑荷的强度图样，但此前该相位-强度转换是否依赖于特定的拉盖尔-高斯径向分布尚不明确，也缺少对其他径向结构光束及矢量光束的定量分析。

Method: 推导高阶贝塞尔-高斯光束与完美光学涡旋场经像散变换后的解析表达式，分析强度极小值数目与累积方位相位缠绕的关系；对两类光束进行数值仿真与实验测量验证；进而将方法推广至空间与偏振自由度耦合的不可分矢量贝塞尔-高斯光束，采用偏振分辨探测。

Result: 解析与实验结果表明，尽管贝塞尔-高斯、完美光学涡旋与拉盖尔-高斯光束的径向结构差异显著，像散变换后强度极小值的数目仍直接由累积方位相位缠绕决定；数值仿真与实验测量在两族光束上均证实该结论；偏振分辨探测可独立确定矢量贝塞尔-高斯光束各组成空间模式的拓扑荷。

Conclusion: 像散变换被确立为标量结构光场拓扑荷的直接探测方法，其有效性不依赖具体径向分布；结合偏振分辨检测，可进一步用于不可分矢量结构光场中空间模式拓扑荷的独立测量。

Abstract: Astigmatic transformation is widely used to convert the azimuthal phase structure of Laguerre-Gaussian vortex beams into intensity patterns from which the topological charge can be read out. Here, we show that this phase-to-intensity conversion is not just restricted to the Laguerre-Gaussian radial profile. We derive analytical expressions for the astigmatically transformed high-order Bessel--Gauss and perfect optical vortex fields, and find that, despite their substantially different radial structures, the number of intensity minima is directly set by the accumulated azimuthal phase winding. Numerical simulations and experimental measurements on both beam families confirm this result, establishing astigmatic transformation as a direct probe of the topological charge of scalar structured optical fields. We further extend the approach to non-separable vector Bessel-Gauss beams, in which the spatial and polarization degrees of freedom are coupled, and show that polarization-resolved detection allows the topological charge of the constituent spatial modes to be determined independently.

</details>


### [199] [Predictive electronic feedback control for narrow-linewidth lasers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31396)
*Jiatian Liu,Xuan Qi,Xiayang Fan,Shenchao Jin,Yuan Sun*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出基于Smith预测器的通用方法，在PDH反馈环的电子部分内部补偿时延，仅增加一个FPGA即可抑制相位噪声与伺服凸起。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 窄线宽激光器在量子相干控制、精密测量与量子信息中至关重要，PDH稳频是标准手段，但反馈环固有时间延迟会引入过量相位噪声（伺服凸起）；已有方案多依赖环外附加光学器件，硬件复杂。

Method: 将Smith预测器引入PDH电子反馈控制环，利用其对被控对象时延的预估模型实现时延补偿，仅在环内增加一个FPGA控制器实现。

Result: 系统验证了该方法在抑制相位噪声、降低伺服凸起方面的有效性，且硬件开销极小。

Conclusion: 该方法概念简洁、实用有效、硬件代价低，可推广至广泛的激光稳频与相关应用场景。

Abstract: Narrow-linewidth lasers are essential for various key atom-laser interaction processes and optical setups in quantum coherent control, quantum precision measurement, and quantum information science. The Pound-Drever-Hall (PDH) technique is the standard method for the frequency-stabilization of narrow-linewidth lasers, but the inherent time delay in its feedback loop inevitably induces excessive phase noise, commonly known as servo bumps. Previous solutions primarily rely on additional optical components outside the electronic feedback control loop. Here, we propose and implement a generic method based on the Smith predictor to address the time-delay issue entirely within the electronic part of the PDH feedback control loop. We systematically demonstrate its capability to suppress phase noise and reduce servo bumps by adding only a single Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) controller to the loop. This class of methods is demonstrated to be conceptually concise with minimal hardware overhead, effective in practice, and holds potential for a wide variety of future applications.

</details>


### [200] [Observation of Polarization Topology in Magneto-Optical BICs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31498)
*Yaqi Li,Mingyu Tong,Fujia Chen,Li Zhang,Rui Zhao,Yuze Hu,Bei Wu,Haiyao Luo,Hongsheng Chen,Yihao Yang*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 实验重建了磁光BIC的二维远场本征偏振织构，测得其拓扑荷q=+1，并发现仅调节磁偏置强度即可翻转偏振手性而拓扑荷不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光子连续域束缚态（BIC）的动量空间偏振拓扑由远场偏振绕数定义的量子化拓扑荷表征；磁光BIC虽将偏振拓扑与磁可调手性结合，但时间反演对称性破缺使本征偏振提取困难，实验表征一直是挑战。

Method: 对偏振分辨的角度分辨反射矩阵做奇异值分解（不依赖互易性）提取共振输出偏振，重建二维远场本征偏振织构；并建立非厄米耦合模模型解释手性翻转机制。

Result: 重建的偏振方位角绕Γ点奇点逆时针缠绕2π，拓扑荷q=+1；仅改变磁偏置强度即可反转偏振手性，而磁场方向与测得拓扑荷保持不变；耦合模模型将手性翻转归因于BIC模式与泄漏模式的杂化。

Conclusion: 该工作首次实现非互易光子学中动量空间偏振拓扑的实验获取，为研究拓扑奇点及其在主动时间反演破缺下的演化开辟了途径。

Abstract: Polarization topology in momentum space is a fundamental characteristic of photonic bound states in the continuum (BICs), where the winding of far-field polarization defines a quantized topological charge. Although magneto-optical (MO) BICs combine polarization topology with magnetically tunable chirality, experimental characterization remains challenging because time-reversal symmetry (TRS) breaking complicates eigenpolarization extraction. Here, we experimentally resolve the momentum-space polarization topology of an MO BIC by reconstructing its two-dimensional far-field eigenpolarization texture. We extract the resonant output polarization using singular value decomposition of the polarization-resolved angle-resolved reflection matrix without invoking reciprocity. The reconstructed polarization azimuth winds counterclockwise by 2$π$ around the $Γ$-point singularity, yielding a topological charge of q = +1. Moreover, the polarization handedness can be reversed solely by varying the magnetic-bias strength, while the field direction and the measured topological charge remain unchanged. A non-Hermitian coupled-mode model traces this reversal to hybridization between the BIC mode and a leaky mode. This work establishes experimental access to momentum-space polarization topology in nonreciprocal photonics, opening a route to explore topological singularities and their evolution under active TRS breaking.

</details>

### [201] [Verified DRAM Address Mapping Reverse Engineering with Threshold Sweep](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30397)
*Hewen Zhang,Ian G. Harris*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该文提出一个端到端软件流水线，用于在嵌入式 LPDDR5 系统上求解并验证 DRAM 地址映射函数，基于延迟数据集、阈值扫描、Knock-Knock 线性约束求解与 GF(2) RREF 恢复 bank mask，并通过分组验证与单函数验证进行评估，同时记录各阈值下的候选映射与指标以支持更稳健的选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常只输出单一推断映射，缺乏系统性验证与多候选比较，且针对 ARM 嵌入式 LPDDR5 平台的支持不足；同时 Rowhammer 分析需要可靠的 DRAM 地址映射逆向结果。

Method: 从地址对的延迟数据集构建延迟直方图，进行阈值扫描获得候选同 bank 地址对；对每个阈值采用 Knock-Knock 风格线性约束求解器恢复候选 bank mask，并用 GF(2) 行最简形（RREF）计算最终 mask；设计分组验证与单函数验证两级验证：前者检查恢复 mask 诱导的 bank 划分与实测时序行为是否一致，后者逐一移除单个地址函数并测量验证通过率变化。

Result: 该流水线在每个候选阈值下系统记录求解得到的 bank mask 与验证指标，而非仅返回单一映射；在 ARM 嵌入式设备上实现了更稳健的 bank mask 选择。

Conclusion: 该工作为嵌入式 LPDDR5 平台提供了一套高效、可验证的 DRAM 地址映射逆向工程流程，提升了映射选择的稳健性，并可为后续 Rowhammer 分析提供支撑。

Abstract: We propose an end-to-end software pipeline for solving and validating DRAM address mapping functions on embedded LPDDR5 systems, and we instantiate it on embedded platforms. Starting from a large latency dataset of address pairs, the pipeline first builds a latency histogram and then performs a threshold sweep to obtain candidate same-bank address pairs. For each threshold, we apply a Knock-Knock-style linear-constraint solver to recover candidate bank masks. Final bank masks are calculated using GF(2) reduced row echelon form (RREF). To verify correctness, we implement two verification stages, group verification and single function verification, inspired by prior work. Group verification checks whether bank partitions induced by the recovered masks agree with observed timing behavior. Single function verification removes one addressing function at a time and measures the resulting change in verification pass rate. Unlike approaches that return only a single inferred mapping, our workflow systematically records, for each candidate threshold, the solved bank masks and validation metrics. This pipeline supports more robust selection of bank masks on ARM-based embedded devices and provides an efficient method for reverse engineering DRAM address mapping functions and subsequent Rowhammer analysis.

</details>


### [202] [Proba: A High-Performance, Low-Traffic Probabilistic Spatial Memory Streaming Prefetcher](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30448)
*Yinting Huang,Jacky Wong,Sam Ainsworth*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: Proba 是一个反馈驱动的 SMS 预取器，通过概率化模式更新、边际精度决策与多触发特征的模式累积，实现细粒度精度-覆盖率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 SMS 预取器对激进度控制粗糙，难以适应动态程序行为与历史访问模式。

Method: 集成概率化模式更新、边际精度决策机制，并在多个触发特征上累积模式，以动态调节预取激进度。

Result: 相比其他 SMS 预取器取得更高加速比，同时 DRAM 流量显著更低；在多核与 DRAM 受限场景下性能优势明显，且不损害单线程吞吐。

Conclusion: 反馈驱动的细粒度精度-覆盖率调节可显著提升 SMS 预取器的能效与适应性。

Abstract: Spatial Memory Streaming (SMS) prefetchers exploit recurring spatial access patterns across memory regions to predict future accesses. Despite their effectiveness, existing SMS-based designs suffer from coarse control over aggressiveness and limited adaptability to dynamic program behavior and historical patterns. In this work, we present Proba, a feedback-directed SMS-based prefetcher that integrates probabilistic pattern updates, marginal accuracy decision-making, and pattern accumulation over several trigger features to achieve fine-grained accuracy-coverage trade-offs. When accuracy deteriorates, Proba moderates its aggressiveness to prioritize accurate prefetches; conversely, when accuracy rises, it expands its coverage. Proba achieves higher speedups than any other SMS-based prefetcher while being vastly more efficient in DRAM traffic. This culminates in a large performance gap between Proba and other techniques in multicore and DRAM-constrained scenarios without harming single-threaded throughput.

</details>


### [203] [FIGFLEX: A Mixed-Precision FP-INT GEMM Accelerator Co-Designed with Low-Bit LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30480)
*Faraz Tahmasebi,Haocheng Xu,Andrew Trauger,Yomal Perera,Zhenyu Tang,Nael Chowdhury,Sitao Huang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: FIGFLEX 是一个算法-硬件协同设计的混合精度加速器，通过 radix-4 移位加重构与配套混合精度量化器，使 FP-INT GEMM 吞吐随权重位宽下降而线性提升，在 LLaMA-2-7B 上同时取得更低困惑度与更高面积效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅权重量化把主流负载变为 FP-INT GEMM，但硬件未跟上：GPU 仍需先把权重反量化到 FP16 再用张量核 MAC，位并行 FP-INT 加速器又只支持单一精度，因此减少位宽只省内存、不省计算。作者希望位宽下降能真正转化为吞吐收益，同时保持混合精度量化的精度不退化。

Method: 硬件侧：(1) 提出 FP-INT 乘法的 radix-4 移位加重构，将 MAC 融合为统一的、精度灵活的部分积归约，部分积数量约减半；(2) 提出 INT3 专用优化，回收 radix-4 在 3-bit 下闲置的数据通路。算法侧：混合精度量化器按"GPTQ 无法补偿的误差"为每个通道组分配位宽，并采用逐输入通道列缩放，其 2 的幂归一化使缩放后激活不落入 FP16 次正规数范围，从而量化模型可直接映射到 FIGFLEX 数据通路且精度与 GPU 上一致。

Result: LLaMA-2-7B 上，3-bit/2-bit 平均精度下 WikiText-2 困惑度为 5.85 与 8.77，优于 GPTQ、AWQ、SliM-LLM、AMQ 与 QuIP#（无微调）；在 3-bit 混合精度模型线性 GEMM 上，整芯片单位面积吞吐分别比 AxCore 与 FIGLUT 高 1.56 倍与 1.42 倍。

Conclusion: 通过把精度灵活的部分积归约与误差驱动的混合精度量化协同设计，可在不牺牲精度的前提下让低比特权重真正换取计算吞吐与面积效率，说明算法-硬件联合优化是释放仅权重量化收益的有效路径。

Abstract: Weight-only quantization keeps LLM activations in floating point and stores weights as low-bit integers, turning the dominant workload into floating-point-integer (FP-INT) general matrix multiplication. Recent quantizers reach a 2-3-bit average with mixed precision, but hardware has not kept pace: GPUs dequantize weights to FP16 before the tensor-core multiply-accumulate, and bit-parallel FP-INT accelerators run at a single weight precision, so fewer bits save memory but not computation. In this paper, we present FIGFLEX, an algorithm-hardware co-designed mixed-precision accelerator whose bit-parallel datapath scales throughput as precision falls. FIGFLEX contributes (1) a shift-add, radix-4 reformulation of FP-INT multiplication that fuses the multiply-accumulate into a unified, precision-flexible partial-product reduction and roughly halves the partial products, together with a novel INT3 optimization that reclaims the idle datapath radix-4 leaves at that precision; and (2) a mixed-precision quantizer that assigns each channel group its bit-width according to the error GPTQ cannot compensate, with a per-input-channel column scaling whose power-of-two normalization keeps the scaled activations out of the FP16 subnormal range, so that the quantized model maps directly onto FIGFLEX's datapath with the same accuracy as on a GPU. On LLaMA-2-7B, FIGFLEX attains 5.85 and 8.77 WikiText-2 perplexity at 3- and 2-bit average precision, lower than GPTQ, AWQ, SliM-LLM, AMQ, and QuIP# (without fine-tuning), while delivering 1.56x and 1.42x higher whole-chip throughput per area on the linear GEMMs of a 3-bit mixed-precision model than AxCore and FIGLUT, respectively.

</details>


### [204] [HDLouvain: High-Throughput Incremental Clustering for Hyperdimensional Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30687)
*Beenish Gul,Mahbod Afarin,Farhat Ahmed,Sumukh Pinge,Tsung-Han Lu,Tajana Rosing,Kevin Skadron*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: HDLouvain 将 Louvain 社区检测与超维计算（HDC）的位并行相似度计算结合，解决流式 shotgun 蛋白质组学谱图聚类的可扩展性问题，在五个 PRIDE 数据集上实现 1.65–4.5 倍加速且模块度不低于全量重算的 8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代 shotgun 蛋白质组学每小时产生数万张串联质谱、数百 GB 数据，传统聚类流程难以承受。DBSCAN 对数据密度不稳定，HAC 为 O(n²)，二者聚类质量均较差；Louvain 等图方法质量高但在流式数据上扩展性差。作者认为 Louvain 的可扩展性问题可在不牺牲质量的前提下解决。

Method: HDLouvain 先对流的一个 bootstrap 比例 α 按前体质量分桶，对每个桶的 kNN 相似度图运行 Louvain；再将每个社区用按位多数投票（bitwise-majority bundling）压缩为单个二值超向量，取代迭代质心重算。新谱图通过 GPU 加速的汉明距离在其质量桶内与代表向量匹配，若无匹配满足相似度阈值 τ 则新建簇，从而增量式扩展划分而无需全量重聚类。

Result: 在五个 PRIDE 数据集（0.99M–21.13M 谱图）上将 α 从 0.2 扫到 0.9，呈现显式单调的吞吐-保真度权衡。PXD003258 上 α=0.3 时加速 4.5 倍，α=0.7 时 1.65 倍；模块度从 α=0.2 的 0.75–0.76 升至 α=0.9 的 0.95–0.97，始终比全量静态重算低不超过 8%。Louvain 阶段在 30k–2M 节点的 LFR 基准网络上达到 0.86–0.93 NMI，而 DBSCAN 与 HAC 退化至 0.57。

Conclusion: 以 HDC 位并行表示与增量分配为主要开销削减手段，可在保持 Louvain 聚类质量的同时获得显著吞吐提升，并给出可调的 α 参数以适配不同精度—速度需求，优于 DBSCAN 与 HAC 的质量-规模表现。

Abstract: Modern shotgun proteomics generates tens of thousands of tandem mass spectra per hour, producing hundreds of gigabytes of data that strain conventional clustering pipelines. DBSCAN and hierarchical agglomerative clustering (HAC) offer flexible similarity search, but DBSCAN is unstable across varying data densities, HAC costs $O(n^2)$, and both yield poor cluster quality. Graph-based methods such as Louvain produce high-quality clusters but scale poorly on streaming data. We observe that Louvain's poor scalability can be resolved without sacrificing its quality, and present HDLouvain, which combines Louvain community detection with the bit-parallel similarity computation of hyperdimensional computing (HDC). HDLouvain partitions a bootstrap fraction of the stream into precursor-mass buckets, applies Louvain to each bucket's kNN similarity graph, and condenses each community into a single binary hypervector by bitwise-majority bundling rather than iterative centroid recomputation. New spectra are assigned by a GPU-accelerated Hamming distance lookup against representatives in their mass bucket, or seed a new cluster when no match meets a similarity threshold $τ$, so the partition grows incrementally without full re-clustering. On five PRIDE datasets (0.99M to 21.13M spectra), sweeping the bootstrap fraction $α$ from 0.2 to 0.9 exposes an explicit, monotonic throughput-fidelity trade-off. On PXD003258, speedup ranges from 4.5x at $α=0.3$ to 1.65x at $α=0.7$. Modularity rises from 0.75-0.76 at $α=0.2$ to 0.95-0.97 at $α=0.9$, never more than 8% below full static recomputation. The Louvain stage achieves 0.86-0.93 normalized mutual information (NMI) on LFR benchmark networks with 30k to 2M nodes, whereas DBSCAN and HAC degrade to 0.57.

</details>


### [205] [SnakeCharmer: Orchestrating Utility, Timeliness, and Placement in GPU Prefetching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30990)
*Yuhan Tang,Tiejun Li,Jianmin Zhang,An Hu,Guangyu Sun,Sheng Ma,Yiqun Lang,Hanqing Li,Siqing Fu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: SnakeCharmer 是一个面向基于地址预测的 GPU 预取器的统一后端预取控制框架，将地址预测与预取实现解耦，联合优化效用、及时性与驻留位置，在 A100 模型上相较 Snake 提升性能/能效 12.8%/20.8%，相较 APOGEE 提升 1.7%/3.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPU 依靠大规模线程级并行容忍长内存延迟，但大量 warp 同时等待访存数据时仍产生严重停顿。基于地址预测的预取器可缓解停顿，但仅有准确预测并不保证性能收益：预测的预取只有在"值得发起、时机恰当、且不被干扰地驻留"时才有效。上述三个需求相互耦合，单独优化任一维度只会把瓶颈转移到别处。

Method: 提出"预测预取到实现收益"（predicted-prefetch-to-realized-benefit）视角，并设计 SnakeCharmer 统一后端预取控制框架。其将地址预测与预取实现分离：前端预测器产生预取候选，后端控制路径联合决定每个候选是否发起、何时发起、返回数据驻留于何处。具体机制包括：零值感知过滤（utility）、层级反馈驱动的距离调优（timeliness）、寄存器辅助的预取缓冲区（placement）。实现主要基于 Snake，并将同一后端控制原则适配到 APOGEE。

Result: 在 A100 GPU 模型上，SnakeCharmer 相较 Snake 提升性能/能效 12.8%/20.8%，相较 APOGEE 提升 1.7%/3.2%，硬件开销适中。

Conclusion: 预取收益需从效用、及时性、驻留三方面协同控制，而非孤立优化预测准确率；后端控制路径可与前端预测器解耦并具备跨预测器通用性，验证了框架不局限于单一前端设计。

Abstract: GPUs rely on massive thread-level parallelism to tolerate long memory latency, yet they still suffer severe stalls when many warps simultaneously wait for data from the memory system. Address-prediction-based GPU prefetchers can mitigate such stalls, but accurate prediction alone does not guarantee performance improvement: a predicted prefetch becomes beneficial only if it is worth issuing, arrives at the right time, and is retained without harmful interference. Because these requirements interact, optimizing any single dimension in isolation can simply move the bottleneck to another.
  We capture these requirements with a predicted-prefetch-to-realized-benefit perspective and propose SnakeCharmer, a unified backend prefetch-control framework for address-prediction-based GPU prefetchers. SnakeCharmer separates address prediction from prefetch realization: the frontend predictor generates prefetch candidates, while the backend control path jointly controls utility, timeliness, and placement by determining whether each candidate should be issued, when it should be issued, and where the returned data should be retained. SnakeCharmer realizes this control path with zero-value-aware filtering for utility, hierarchical feedback-driven distance tuning for timeliness, and a register-assisted prefetch buffer for placement. We design and implement SnakeCharmer primarily on top of Snake, and adapt the same backend-control principles to APOGEE to demonstrate that SnakeCharmer's benefits are not limited to a single frontend predictor. On an A100 GPU model, SnakeCharmer improves performance/energy efficiency by 12.8%/20.8% over Snake and by 1.7%/3.2% over APOGEE, with modest hardware overhead.

</details>


### [206] [Ray-by-Ray: Fine-Grained Resource Management for GPU Ray Tracing Units](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31630)
*Junrui Pan,Cesar Avalos Baddouh,Kai Ze Ee,Timothy G. Rogers*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出 Ray-by-Ray 方法，将片上缓冲拆分为单条光线粒度并配以轻量管理结构，在不增加缓冲容量的前提下提升 RT 单元利用率和内存级并行，平均性能提升 1.91x，面积开销 0.19%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPU SIMT 执行模型与专用 RT 单元逐线程（逐光线）执行模型之间存在粒度不匹配，导致光线路径的控制流与数据高度发散，线程相干性下降；作者希望验证开源基础设施中的相关假设并找出 RT 流水线中资源管理的低效环节。

Method: 将片上缓冲按单条光线粒度进行分解（Ray-by-Ray），并引入轻量级管理结构，使更多 warp 能并行运行而无需扩大缓冲区容量。

Result: 相比基线平均性能提升 1.91x，面积开销仅 0.19%。

Conclusion: 按光线粒度管理片上资源可有效缓解 SIMT 与 RT 粒度不匹配造成的低效，提升 RT 单元利用率与内存级并行，且硬件代价可忽略。

Abstract: Ray tracing (RT) generates photorealistic images by simulating the physical behavior of light as it interacts with surfaces in a virtual scene. In film production and high-end rendering pipelines, this technique computes global illumination, reflections, refractions, and soft shadows by tracing millions of light rays per frame and accurately modeling their bounces and attenuation. Contemporary GPUs incorporate specialized ray tracing hardware to accelerate key operations in the traversal pipeline. By accelerating these stages in hardware, the unit enables real-time ray tracing for complex scenes that previously required offline computation. However, ray tracing introduces substantial control and data divergence. Each ray may traverse a different set of nodes in the acceleration structure, encounter distinct materials, or terminate at varying depths. This irregularity reduces thread coherence and exposes a fundamental disparity between the GPU SIMT and per-thread execution model of dedicated RT units, where each ray progresses independently.
  In this work, we seek to validate assumptions made in open-source infrastructure and identify potential inefficiencies in resource management within the ray tracing pipeline. To address inefficiency caused by mismatches between SIMT and RT granularities, we propose Ray-by-Ray, which decomposes on-chip buffers into the granularity of individual rays and introduces lightweight management structures that enable more warps to run in parallel without increasing buffer capacity. This approach improves ray tracing unit utilization and increases memory-level parallelism. Experimental results show that Ray-by-Ray achieves an average performance improvement of 1.91x over the baseline, with an area overhead of 0.19\%.

</details>


<div id='physics.app-ph'></div>

# physics.app-ph [[Back]](#toc)

### [207] [Phase-Matched Chirps for Energy-Efficient Excitation of Magneto-Mechanical Resonators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31296)
*Sarah Reiss,Fabian Mohn,Jonas Faltinath,Tobias Knopp*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 该仿真研究比较啁啾磁场激励与恒频激励对磁机械谐振器（MMR）的驱动效率，发现正弦线性下啁啾激励产生最大偏转角，最有利于降低能耗并提升测量时间分辨率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MMR作为无源无线传感与追踪器件，依赖交变磁场激励与感应读出；如何生成高效激励信号以最大化传感器能量收集是待解决的关键挑战。

Method: 通过仿真研究，针对正弦波与矩形波两种波形，将啁啾磁场激励与传统恒频激励进行对比，评估其激励效率。

Result: 不同激励方式的效率存在差异；正弦线性下啁啾激励信号获得最大偏转角。

Conclusion: 正弦线性下啁啾激励在降低能耗与改善测量时间分辨率方面潜力最佳。

Abstract: Magneto-mechanical resonators (MMRs) are a recently proposed class of passive, wireless devices used for sensing and tracking. The operating principle of MMRs relies on an excitation of the sensor by oscillating magnetic fields, followed by an inductive readout to measure the sensor's dynamics. One challenge lies in generating efficient excitation signals to ensure maximum energy harvesting by the sensor. In this simulation study, we focus on chirped magnetic-field excitations and compare their performance with conventional constant-frequency excitation for both sinusoidal and rectangular waveforms. The results indicate varying levels of efficiency, with a sinusoidal linear down-chirp excitation signal yielding the largest deflection angle, offering the best potential for reducing the energy consumption and improving the temporal resolution of the measurement.

</details>


### [208] [Orbital-coherence memory in electrical transport and its self-consistent Maxwell response](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31390)
*Pengfei Zhu*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 论文提出一个约化理论，描述内部电子相干性通过反馈物理电流而改变电输运的机制：在相反宇称双轨道哈密顿量下导出"电流耦合的轨道力"，在显式的矩闭合与碰撞假设下得到具有指数衰减振荡记忆的三态被动响应，预测固定光学权重重新分配及直流电导对相干阻尼的非单调依赖，并给出电荷守恒的空间延拓与Maxwell方程的耦合及可检验的复电导/透射实验方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内部电子相干性能否以及如何影响实电流输运缺乏清晰的约化描述；同时，仅凭电导谱难以区分量子机制与普通多分量弛豫，需要把"精确结论"与"实现该效应所需的微观假设"分开，并提供超越无约束谱拟合的判据。

Method: 构建相反宇称双轨道哈密顿量识别电流耦合轨道力；采用明确陈述的矩闭合与碰撞ansatz，导出三态被动响应与指数衰减振荡记忆核；分析电导的权重守恒与dc电导随相干阻尼的变化；将模型做电荷守恒的空间延拓，通过正能量平衡与Maxwell方程耦合，区分本构响应、纵向集体模与横向电磁模；给出参数可辨识性在有限带宽下的界限分析。

Result: 得到固定光学权重在谱间的再分配，以及固定其余参数时直流电导对相干阻尼的非单调依赖；轨道约化使耦合强度与内禀频率通过共同的裸能级劈裂相互约束；空间延拓保持电荷守恒、满足正能量平衡，并清楚分离本构与集体/电磁模式；给出复电导与透射实验的检验方案及有限带宽下参数辨识极限。

Conclusion: 模型在轨道动力学、输运记忆与电磁可观测量之间建立了条件性联系；单靠电导数据不能证明机制的唯一量子来源，仍需材料特定的碰撞计算与闭合误差评估。

Abstract: An internal electronic coherence changes electrical transport only when it feeds back on the physical current. We develop a reduced description of this feedback and distinguish its exact consequences from the assumptions required for a microscopic realization. An opposite-parity two-orbital Hamiltonian identifies a current-coupled orbital force. Under an explicitly stated moment closure and collision ansatz, it yields a passive three-state response with an exponentially damped oscillatory memory. The resulting conductivity redistributes a fixed optical weight and predicts a nonmonotonic dependence of dc conduction on coherence damping at fixed remaining parameters. The orbital reduction constrains the coupling and internal frequency through a shared bare splitting, providing a test beyond unconstrained spectral fitting. A charge-conserving spatial extension couples to Maxwell equations through a positive energy balance and separates the constitutive response from longitudinal collective and transverse electromagnetic modes. We formulate complex-conductivity and transmission tests, including the limits of parameter identification over a finite bandwidth. The model supplies a conditional connection between orbital dynamics, transport memory, and electromagnetic observables; conductivity alone does not establish a uniquely quantum mechanism, and a material-specific collision calculation and closure-error assessment remain necessary.

</details>


### [209] [Analytical Modeling of Modulated Heating for Three-Dimensional Anisotropic Optical Thermometry of Multilayered Cylinders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31424)
*William Spirnock,Dihui Wang,Heng Ban*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 提出首个面向正交各向异性任意分层圆柱的频域热输运解析前向模型，含界面热导与非高斯椭圆光斑的闭式解，可用于非接触测量各向异性热物性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 圆柱几何广泛存在，但材料复杂度与制造工艺导致显著各向异性；现有圆柱热计量只能给出各向同性物性、假设界面完美、且缺乏温度空间分布表达式。

Method: 建立正交各向异性任意分层圆柱频域热输运的解析框架，作为光学热计量前向模型；纳入不可忽略的界面热导，并首次给出有限椭圆光斑高斯激光投射于曲面的闭式解；通过简化假设与二维各向同性文献解比较，并与有限元仿真及各向异性平板模型对照。

Result: 单层与双层各向同性情形下三维模型与既有解吻合、误差可忽略；正交各向异性多层预测与有限元结果在广泛物性和激光几何范围内误差小于1.5%；并明确了平板近似可降低计算量的适用条件。

Conclusion: 建立了首个可用于任意分层圆柱各向异性热物性非接触表征的前向模型。

Abstract: Thermally relevant cylindrical geometries are used in a plethora of applications with thermal property differences depending significantly on material complexity. Manu- facturing processes also induce substantial anisotropy ratios resulting in directionally dependent thermal transport. However, for cylindrical specimens, current thermal metrology resolves only isotropic thermal properties, assumes perfect thermal inter- faces, and offers no formulation for temperature spatial dependence. In this work, we present an analytical framework that models the frequency dependent thermal transport of orthotropic arbitrary layered cylinders to be used as a forward model for existing optical thermometry techniques. This formulation captures the effects of non-negligible thermal boundary conductance and offers the first closed-form solution of a projected Gaussian laser, a common form of heating in thermal metrology, hav- ing a finite elliptic spot size on a curved surface. The novel anisotropic cylindrical model was compared with literature derivations involving two-dimensional isotropic transport for cylinders by applying simplifying assumptions. For single- and two- layerisotropicsamples, thethree-dimensionalmodelagreedwithestablishedsolutions with negligible error, while predictions for orthotropic multilayer samples agreed with finite-element simulations within 1.5% across a range of material properties and laser geometries. Comparison with anisotropic planar models identified conditions under which a planar approximation can reduce computation time. These results estab- lish the first forward model for noncontact characterization of anisotropic thermal properties in arbitrarily layered cylinders.

</details>

### [210] [The Cost of Saying Hello: An Empirical Study of Handshake Overhead in AI Agent Communication Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30151)
*Pranav Varshney*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首个针对智能体协议握手的实证、分阶段基准测试：覆盖MCP（2025 initialize与2026 discover两个版本）、A2A、ACP，用官方SDK对每个请求插桩，测量往返次数、阶段延迟、线上字节与token成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体交互始于握手（定位对端、了解其能力、建立会话），协议综述虽将握手开销列为效率指标，但尚无任何实测报告，缺乏可比数据。

Method: 基于各协议官方SDK对握手全流程插桩，按阶段分解测量往返次数、单阶段延迟、wire字节和token开销；设置冷启动、热重复、能力不匹配、元数据降级四类场景，每格N=50，分别在loopback与模拟50ms RTT下进行。

Result: 往返次数主导握手成本：旧版MCP握手需3次往返、50ms RTT下230ms；A2A仅1次往返、61.0ms。往返并非全部开销：LLM读取对端元数据时，成本随能力清单线性增长（每能力24–107 token），200能力的对端将消耗200k上下文窗口的11%。MCP 2026修订版将握手从3次往返降至2次，配合版本固定可在热重连时降为零。

Conclusion: 握手开销由往返次数与元数据token量共同决定，且可通过协议演进显著优化；MCP 2026的改进反向印证了所测成本的真实性。作者公开了完整测试框架、原始数据与分析代码。

Abstract: Every interaction between AI agents begins with a handshake: the initiating agent must locate its counterpart, learn what it can do, and establish a session before the first useful message can be sent. Surveys of agent communication protocols name handshake overhead as an efficiency criterion, yet none report measurements. This paper presents the first empirical, phase-decomposed benchmark of the handshake in three major agent protocols: MCP (in both its 2025 initialize and 2026 discover eras), A2A, and ACP. Using each protocol's official SDK, we instrument every request for round trips, per-phase latency, wire bytes, and token cost across cold-start, warm-repeat, capability-mismatch, and degraded-metadata scenarios (N=50 per cell, on loopback and under an emulated 50 ms RTT). Round-trip count dominates handshake cost. A legacy MCP handshake takes three round trips and 230 ms at 50 ms RTT; A2A needs one round trip and 61.0 ms. Round trips are not the whole bill: when an LLM reads the counterpart's metadata, handshake cost scales with the counterpart's capability inventory at 24-107 tokens per capability, so a 200-capability counterpart spends 11% of a 200k-token context window before the agent reads its own task. MCP's own 2026 revision cuts its handshake from three round trips to two and, with era pinning, to zero on warm reconnects, protocol evolution that corroborates the cost we measure. We release the full harness, raw data, and analysis at https://github.com/pvarshh/handshake-benchmark.

</details>


### [211] [MCP vs CLI for AI Agents: A Comparative Analysis of Tool Integration Strategies for Autonomous Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30157)
*Arun Malik,Nitish Talasu,Bradley Klemick,Vineet Tushar Trivedi,Prachi Shah,Sanay Devi,Junjie Zhang,Kunal Sonawane*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对AI智能体集成的两大范式——CLI（直接执行shell命令）与MCP（基于JSON-RPC的结构化、受治理、类型化工具访问协议）——进行了跨14个维度的系统比较，结合实例、安全合规评估与经济建模，结论是二者各有优势，生产系统推荐混合架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体需要与文件、API、数据库、云服务等外部系统交互，CLI与MCP两种范式已形成竞争格局，但缺乏系统性、多维度且有安全与经济学支撑的对比分析，难以指导工程选型。

Method: 构建14个评估维度的比较框架，辅以可运行的示例说明；依据NSA正式指南（CSI U/OO/6030316-26）、OWASP安全标准等成熟合规框架进行安全评估；并结合BCG与Gartner的经济建模进行成本效益分析；同时考察渐进式披露（progressive disclosure）技术对MCP上下文开销的影响。

Result: 分析表明：CLI在单用户、纯本地工作流中效率更优；MCP则解决了CLI本质上无法满足的需求，包括细粒度访问控制、凭证隔离、结构化审计和多租户治理。渐进式披露技术消除了MCP历史上的主要短板（上下文窗口开销），使其token效率可与CLI相当，同时保留其架构优势。

Conclusion: CLI与MCP并非简单替代关系，而是面向不同需求层次的互补方案；生产系统应推荐采用混合架构，在本地高效场景使用CLI，在需要治理、安全与多租户的场景使用MCP。

Abstract: AI agents require interfaces to interact with external systems such as files, APIs, databases, and cloud services. Two competing paradigms have emerged: CLI (Command Line Interface), where agents execute shell commands directly, and MCP (Model Context Protocol), a structured JSON-RPC protocol providing governed, typed tool access. This paper presents a comparative analysis across 14 evaluation dimensions, supported by worked examples, security assessment against established compliance frameworks, and economic modeling. Our analysis indicates that CLI provides superior efficiency for single-user, local-only workflows, while MCP addresses requirements that CLI fundamentally cannot satisfy, including fine-grained access control, credential isolation, structured audit, and multi-tenant governance. We further examine how progressive disclosure techniques eliminate MCP's historical weakness (context window overhead), yielding token efficiency comparable to CLI while preserving its architectural benefits. A hybrid architecture is recommended for production systems. This analysis draws upon academic, government, and industry sources including NSA formal guidance (CSI U/OO/6030316-26), OWASP security standards, and economic modeling from BCG and Gartner.

</details>


### [212] [Accelerating Wildfire Hazard Mapping Across Canada with an AI Surrogate Modelling Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30170)
*Hager Radi Abdelwahed,Toluwaleke Olutayo,Chirag Goel,Jana Osea,Aldo Zaimi,Tom Swystun,Sandy Erni,Francisco Emiliano Lopez Saavedra,Yan Boulanger,Gaétan Marceau Caron*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于AI代理模型替代BurnP3+过程式野火模拟：建立标准化训练/评估框架，构建多任务深度学习代理模型，一次推理秒级输出燃烧概率、平均火强度与蔓延速率，在代表性区域实现806倍CPU加速、仅占13%主机内存，并保持下游危险性分类与反事实合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加拿大野火活动加剧，需频繁开展全国尺度危险性制图以支撑燃料管理、土地利用规划、基础设施防护与疏散路径设计；但BurnP3/BurnP3+等基于过程的模拟依赖计算密集的蒙特卡洛方法，单个区域建模单元需数天至数周，形成计算瓶颈。

Method: AI研究者与野火建模专家协作，贡献三点：(a) 标准化框架，用于训练、微调并对照过程式模拟器评估AI代理模型；(b) 多任务深度学习代理模型，融合燃料、地形、点火概率等地理空间数据与区域气象，在全国尺度数据上训练，同时模拟燃烧概率、平均火强度与平均蔓延速率；(c) 领域专用指标与反事实评估协议，用于探测分布外泛化能力。

Result: 模型在一致性、秩相关、误差与空间重叠等多类指标上表现良好，逼近BurnP3+输出；能保持下游危险性等级分类，并对专家设计的反事实干预给出物理上合理的响应；代表性区域端到端CPU加速806倍，主机内存占用仅为BurnP3+的13%。

Conclusion: 深度学习代理模型可在秒级、低资源条件下高保真复现过程式野火模拟结果，为快速情景分析和大规模全国危险性制图提供可行路径。

Abstract: Canada's increasing wildfire activity requires frequent national hazard mapping to guide proactive mitigation, including fuel management, land-use planning, infrastructure protection, and evacuation routing. However, process-based wildfire simulation frameworks (e.g., BurnP3 and BurnP3+) rely on computationally intensive Monte Carlo simulations to model burn probability, fire intensity, and rate of spread. These workflows can take days to weeks to process a single regional modelling unit. To overcome these computational bottlenecks, we present three contributions developed through collaboration between AI researchers and wildfire modelling experts: (a) a standardized framework for training, fine-tuning, and evaluating AI surrogate models against process-based wildfire simulators; (b) a multi-task deep learning surrogate trained on national-scale data to emulate burn probability, mean fire intensity, and mean rate of spread at a fraction of the computational cost (seconds); and (c) domain-specific metrics and counterfactual evaluation protocols to probe out-of-distribution generalization. Integrating geospatial data (fuel, terrain, ignition likelihood) and regional weather, our model approximates BurnP3+ simulation outputs, achieving strong performance across agreement, rank-correlation, error, and spatial-overlap metrics. It preserves downstream hazard classifications and produces physically plausible responses to expert-informed counterfactual interventions. On a representative region, the surrogate achieves 806-fold end-to-end CPU acceleration and uses 13% of BurnP3+'s host memory, facilitating rapid scenario analysis.

</details>


### [213] [Neural Networks with Differentiable Belief-Function Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30173)
*Antonin Sulc*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文指出Dempster归一化因子在反向传播中引入(1-κ)^{-2}项，冲突大时梯度发散；据此构建全链使用Yager规则⊕的证据深度网络，使m(Θ)成为可读的"我不知道"信号，并在视觉/语言两模态上验证其能排序人类分歧且具OOD检测竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Dempster规则在证据冲突时把质量重新归一化分配到类别单纯形上，其归一化因子(1-κ)^{-1}会在梯度中产生(1-κ)^{-2}项，恰在证据源相互冲突时发散，不利于端到端训练；而Yager 1987年基于认知论提出在高冲突下应把质量转给无知集，这一需求与反向传播的需求相吻合，且Yager规则是双线性的、无此发散项。

Method: 构建深度证据流水线：从各检测头到输出的每一环质量都保持为合法Dempster–Shafer质量函数，统一用Yager规则⊕组合；网络以硬标签训练，从不接触标注者分布；输出无知集质量m(Θ)作为"我不知道"信号。

Result: 在视觉与语言两模态上，m(Θ)均能对人工标注分歧进行排序；Dempster的对应量也能排序，但其归一化把冲突剥离出去，在最争议的CIFAR-10H图像上Yager的空泛度是Dempster的9倍，故只有Yager的m(Θ)无需重校准即可解读为无知量；OOD检测上与强单遍基线相当，而采用截断(clamp)的Dempster变体虽得分更高，但去掉截断后梯度不稳定。

Conclusion: 梯度稳定性要求与Yager规则的认知论主张一致：应以Yager⊕替代Dempster归一化来构建深度证据网络；Yager的m(Θ)是可解释的无知度量并具备实用OOD能力，而依赖clamp的Dempster高分是以梯度稳定性为代价的。

Abstract: Yager's 1987 rule of combination $\boxplus$ was proposed on epistemic grounds: under high conflict, mass should be redistributed to ignorance rather than renormalised onto the class simplex. We observe that backpropagation needs the same rule: Dempster's normaliser $(1{-}κ)^{-1}$, where $κ$ is the conflict mass, puts a $(1{-}κ)^{-2}$ term in the gradient that diverges exactly when evidence sources disagree, while Yager's $\boxplus$ is bilinear and has no such term. Building on this, we construct a deep evidential pipeline in which every mass in the chain from heads to output is a valid Dempster--Shafer mass function, combined by Yager's rule. The output mass on the ignorance set, $m(Θ)$, serves as the network's ``I do not know'' signal. The network is fit to hard labels and never sees an annotator distribution, yet $m(Θ)$ orders human disagreement in two modalities, visual and linguistic. Dempster's rises too and ranks contested inputs about as well, but its normaliser divides the conflict out: Yager's vacuity is $9\times$ larger on the most contested CIFAR-10H images, so only Yager's is readable as an amount of ignorance without recalibration. For out-of-distribution detection it is competitive with strong single-pass baselines, while the clamped Dempster variant that scores higher becomes gradient-unstable once the clamp is removed.

</details>


### [214] [When Stable and Preferred Semantics Agree: A Path-Based Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30176)
*Yan Zhang,Kehan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出基于攻击图中路径集及其诱导二元关系的通用判据，用以刻画抽象论辩框架中preferred语义与stable语义一致的结构条件，并严格推广有限争议性与SCC对称性两条经典判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: preferred与stable语义的一致性在文献中仅有少数结构性充分条件（Dung的limited controversiality与SCC-symmetry），缺乏统一、可扩展的刻画框架，本文旨在建立更一般的路径视角。

Method: 选取攻击图中适当路径集，并由这些路径诱导二元关系；建立基于路径的语义一致性一般判据，再以多类路径实例化，用相应关系（良基性等）表达充分条件。取偶路径集可复现Dung结果，并构造两个无限路径集序列，其中第一个经Collapse Theorem将无穷多良基性条件归约为三个本质不同条件，第二个不坍缩。

Result: 所得条件严格推广limited controversiality与SCC-symmetry；第一个序列的无限条件坍缩为三类，第二个序列给出真正互异且无坍缩的条件族；结果同时适用于有限与无限框架，有限情形有简化表述，并给出stable扩展存在的充分条件。

Conclusion: 路径集加诱导关系的框架统一并严格拓广了preferred–stable一致性的结构判据，且可迁移到stable扩展存在性问题，具备理论与实践双重价值。

Abstract: We investigate structural conditions under which preferred and stable semantics agree in abstract argumentation frameworks. Our approach is based on suitably chosen sets of paths in the attack graph and binary relations induced by them. We establish a general path-based criterion for semantic agreement and instantiate it with several classes of paths, obtaining sufficient conditions expressed in terms of well-foundedness of the corresponding relations.
  The resulting conditions strictly generalize two principal structural criteria for preferred and stable agreement in the literature: Dung's limited controversiality condition and the SCC-symmetry condition. In particular, Dung's result is recovered as a special case by taking the relevant path set to be the set of even paths. We further introduce two infinite sequences of path sets, each yielding a family of agreement conditions. For the first sequence, a Collapse Theorem reduces the infinitely many associated well-foundedness conditions to three essentially distinct ones, whereas the second sequence gives rise to genuinely distinct conditions with no analogous collapse. Our results apply to both finite and infinite argumentation frameworks, admit simplified formulations in the finite case, and also yield sufficient conditions for the existence of stable extensions.

</details>


### [215] [Feedback That Backfires in Games: Do LLM Players Repeat the Move They Just Watched Fail?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30205)
*Esmail Gumaan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文检验游戏中失败记录（失败动作+错误信息回写transcript）是否会让小模型更倾向重复失败动作。在Sokoban/Connect Four/Othello上用扰动正确走法构造的探针项测量，发现记录确实"反噬"：8个指令微调模型(135M-1.7B)合并后失败动作更可能被重复（纠正增益G=-1.38 nats/token），且只经动作表层字符串起作用、仅对非法走法成立、并非所有模型都有；该效应在OLMo 2 1B基座模型中已存在，DPO阶段基本消除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具调用场景中，失败动作被写入记录后会让小模型更容易重犯；作者想验证该现象是否同样存在于游戏中——游戏的失败可被精确判定为"非法"或"合法但致败"，因此能更干净地区分失败类型与机制。

Method: 在Sokoban、Connect Four、Othello中，通过扰动一个正确走法构建固定探针项，并用精确验证器判定走法非法或致败。在8个指令微调模型(135M–1.7B)上测量纠正增益G（失败记录出现后失败动作的对数概率变化），并做探索性分析（前后概率斜率、贪心解码重复率）、消融（去掉动作字符串的失败描述）、沿OLMo 2 1B后训练阶梯的追踪、RAGEN默认模型在其原生Sokoban格式下的测试，以及"不要重复"指令、干净重试、解码期禁用等干预对比。全部测量在float32下的免费Colab GPU上完成。

Result: 合并8个模型后G=-1.38 nats/token，即记录反而提高失败动作概率；效应经动作表层形式传递，对非法走法明显而对致败走法不成立，且存在模型间差异。记录后失败动作对数概率几乎不依赖其先前概率（斜率0.18）：模型本不会走的动作变得更可能被贪心解码产出，而原本倾向的动作概率下降但仍有38%被贪心重复。省略动作字符串的失败描述可保留模型原有偏好。OLMo 2 1B阶梯上该反转在基座模型即已存在、DPO阶段基本消除；RAGEN默认模型在未做RL前已在其Sokoban格式中反转。"不要重复"指令无效，干净重试是最差harness，解码禁令仅阻止完全重复而不能阻止非法操作。复现了原论文数值。

Conclusion: 失败回写这一常见harness设计在游戏环境中同样会诱导小模型复现失败动作，其机制是动作表层字符串的显著性压过了模型原有的策略偏好，且该效应与RL前的基座状态密切相关。由此，harness层面的修补（指令、干净重试、解码禁令）均无法根治，需从数据/后训练（如DPO）与记录设计（弱化动作原文字面）入手。

Abstract: When an LLM agent's move fails, the harness writes the move and the failure message into the transcript and asks again. In tool calling, this record makes small models more likely to repeat the failed action. We test whether the same holds in games (Sokoban, Connect Four, Othello), where a move can fail by being illegal or by being legal but losing, both verified exactly. On fixed probe items built by perturbing a correct move, the record backfires: pooled over 8 instruction-tuned models (135M-1.7B) it makes the failed move more likely (corrective gain G = -1.38 nats per token), through the move's surface form, for illegal moves but not for losing ones, and not for every model. An exploratory analysis shows what sets the sign: after the record, the failed move's log-probability barely depends on how likely it was before (slope 0.18). Moves the model would not have played become more likely, and greedy decoding starts to produce them; moves it was about to play become less likely, but greedy decoding still repeats 38% of them. A description of the failure that omits the move string keeps the model's preference instead. Along the OLMo 2 1B post-training ladder the inversion is present in the base model and largely removed at the DPO stage. RAGEN's default models invert in RAGEN's own Sokoban format before any RL. A "do not repeat" instruction does nothing, a clean retry is the worst harness, and a decoder ban stops exact repeats but not illegal play. All measurements ran in float32 on a free Colab GPU, which first reproduced the original paper's number.

</details>


### [216] [Breaking the high-degree barrier in Lehmer's problem with a human-AI discovery loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30277)
*Yuri Chervonyi,Sergei Gukov,Thang Luong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过人机协同发现循环，提出五参数的广义Boyd算法，为任意偶数度构造Mahler测度低于Boyd极限点α₁≈1.255434的不可约整系数多项式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Lehmer问题（1933）关注整系数多项式的Mahler测度能否任意小。此前系统构造仅覆盖偶数度d≤180；更高次数下Boyd的单参数解析族常发生因子分解，跳过近50%的目标次数，且无适用于任意d的一般构造方法。

Method: 采用人机-AI发现循环：在对话式提示基础上扩展快速数值流水线、精确符号验证器和大规模分布式搜索；AI代理本地原型化数值与符号求解器，在分布式集群上并行搜索，并与人类研究者共同提取和验证数学假设，最终推导五参数广义Boyd算法。

Result: 广义Boyd算法消除了degree-skipping，对每个目标偶数度构造不可约整系数多项式且Mahler测度严格低于α₁。在≤2000的所有偶数度上评估，改进了6个已发表数值，保持99.6%的已知最优记录。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了适用于任意度的一般构造，展示了人机协同+分布式计算在数学探索中的有效性，并公开了所有已研究偶数度的最小Mahler测度多项式验证数据集。

Abstract: While artificial intelligence has made rapid progress in mathematical reasoning, many open problems depend on structure that is revealed only through large-scale computational exploration and analytical synthesis. One such example is Lehmer's problem from 1933. It asks whether the Mahler measure of an integer polynomial, which measures how far its roots stray from the unit circle, can be made arbitrarily small. Previously, constructing irreducible polynomials with integer coefficients and small Mahler measure has been carried out systematically only for even degrees $d \le 180$. At higher degrees, Boyd's analytical one-parameter family frequently factors, skipping nearly 50% of target degrees and leaving no general construction for arbitrary $d$. Here, we address the high-degree regime through a human-AI discovery loop, in which we extend the conversational prompting with a fast numerical pipeline, an exact symbolic verifier, and large-scale distributed search. The AI agent prototypes numerical and symbolic solvers locally, launches parallel searches across distributed clusters and works with the human researcher to extract and verify mathematical hypotheses. Through this interactive loop, we derive a five-parameter construction, which we call the Generalized Boyd algorithm. It eliminates degree-skipping and constructs irreducible polynomials with Mahler measure strictly below Boyd's limit point $α_1 \approx 1.255434$ for every target degree. Evaluated across all even degrees up to 2000, our approach improves upon six previously published values and holds 99.6% of all best known records. With this work we release the verified dataset of polynomials with minimal Mahler measure across all studied even degrees.

</details>


### [217] [Route-and-Generate: KL-Regularized Router Improvement for Reasoning Routing in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30351)
*Tien-Phat Nguyen,Truong Nguyen,Thanh-Thien Le,Hoang Phan,Thien Huu Nguyen,Linh Ngo Van,Trung Le*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Route-and-Generate (Rouge) 分层训练框架，使 LLM 能按输入自适应决定推理的时机与强度，在多个推理基准上取得更优的精度-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型常不加区分地使用复杂推理，导致简单任务过度思考、困难任务思考不足，缺乏对推理努力的自适应分配。
