Empirically, distances in the learned embedding follow the hierarchy distance more closely than those of the input, although the hierarchy is never observed during training. On synthetic hierarchies, NEST recovers multiscale structure given only the number of clusters per level. Experiments on vision, text, and single-cell data further demonstrate multiscale organization across real-world representations. By making clustering granularity an intrinsic property of the representation, NEST provides a unified approach to multiscale structure discovery.

</details>


### [356] [When News Gets Old: Portfolio Allocation with Reinforcement Learning and Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30564)
*Bolin Song,Surui Xiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究金融新闻"时效性"信号处理：保留旧新闻为组合策略提供择时信息，或在选股前将其过滤掉。用固定LLM从SEC公开披露中抽取信号，比较RL策略与直接选组合的LLM。2023–2025历史回测（扣交易成本）显示：RL在受控实验中会响应时效信息，但历史收益无一致增益；LLM过滤旧新闻取得最高平均净收益，新闻延迟四周时达年化18.43%，优于所有使用新闻的RL策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融新闻的影响在发布后长期存在：及时新闻可能在价格充分调整前被投资者获取，而陈旧新闻可能已反映在价格中。作者关注"信号老化"这一被忽视的问题，试图厘清该如何处理老化信号——保留以提供择时信息，还是过滤以避免信息冗余。

Method: 采用固定的大型语言模型（LLM）从公开SEC披露文件中抽取新闻信号；设计两种处理方式（保留全部信号 / 过滤陈旧信号）进行对比；分别在强化学习（RL）策略以及直接输出组合的LLM中实现；在2023–2025年历史数据上以扣交易成本后的收益为评价指标，并设置受控实验检验RL是否利用时效信息，同时考察新闻延迟四周等场景。

Result: RL决策在受控测试中对时效信息有响应，但历史回测中引入时效信息未带来一致的收益提升。对LLM而言，过滤旧新闻带来最高的平均净收益：新闻投递延迟四周时年化净收益达18.43%，高于所有使用新闻的RL策略。

Conclusion: 处理老化新闻信号的方式显著影响组合表现，且不同决策主体差异明显：LLM直接选组合时"过滤旧新闻"更优，而RL虽能感知时效信息却难以转化为实际收益。结果提示信号的时效管理应结合决策架构设计，而非一律保留或剔除。

Abstract: Financial news can influence investment decisions long after publication. Timely news may reach an investor before prices fully adjust, whereas older news may already be reflected in prices. We examine two ways to handle aging signals: retain them and give a portfolio policy timing information, or filter them out before portfolio selection. A fixed large language model (LLM) extracts signals from public SEC disclosures. We compare these treatments in reinforcement learning (RL) policies and LLMs that choose portfolios directly. We evaluate returns after trading costs in historical tests over 2023-2025. RL choices respond to timing information in a controlled test, but historical returns show no consistent benefit from adding it. For the LLM, filtering old news produced the highest average net return, reaching 18.43% per year when news delivery was delayed by four weeks. This exceeded the returns of all RL strategies that used news.

</details>


### [357] [Evaluating Type-1 Diabetes Digital Twins by Decision Quality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30577)
*Victor Li,Owen Tucker,Michael S. Hughes,Temiloluwa Prioleau,Shengpu Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出以"下游治疗排序决策质量"直接评价1型糖尿病数字孪生(DT)，而非仅看血糖轨迹预测精度；基于UVA/Padova模型30个虚拟患者×21种基础-餐时治疗方案的实验显示，预测精度与决策质量并不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DT质量传统上以预测血糖轨迹的精度衡量，但该指标未必反映其支持的下游临床决策质量，可能导致选出"预测准但推荐等同随机"的DT。

Method: 构建评价协议：30个FDA认可的UVA/Padova虚拟患者，各在21种基础-餐时治疗下仿真；对每个患者用一种治疗拟合DT，再对剩余20种治疗生成血糖轨迹，并以Spearman相关系数衡量DT对候选治疗的排序与真实排序的一致性。比较六种方法（含平均患者基线、黑箱神经网络等）。

Result: 精度与决策质量出现背离：从未见过个体血糖数据的"平均患者"基线预测精度最差(RMSE 63.6 mg/dL)，但治疗排序Spearman达0.766（第二高）；黑箱神经网络RMSE约好一倍(32.9 mg/dL)，排序Spearman仅0.049，与随机排序相当。

Conclusion: 仅凭预测精度选择DT可能挑中决策等同随机的模型；决策质量须直接评估，不能假定其随预测精度自然提升。

Abstract: A digital twin (DT) for type 1 diabetes (T1D) can predict how an individual's blood glucose will respond to different insulin treatments without actually trying them. For each treatment, downstream statistics of predicted glucose trajectories, such as glycemic risk, can be computed to guide clinical decisions. However, the quality of DTs is usually measured by the accuracy of their predicted glucose trajectories, which may not reflect the quality of the downstream treatment decisions they inform. In this work, we directly evaluate DTs by this decision quality on downstream treatment ranking, i.e., whether a DT predicts glucose trajectories that can be used to rank candidate treatments as the real patient would. We present an evaluation protocol over 30 virtual patients from the FDA-accepted UVA/Padova model, each simulated under 21 different basal-bolus treatments. For each patient, a DT is fitted under one treatment and then produces glucose trajectories for the remaining 20 treatments. Our results show that prediction accuracy and decision quality disagree. A baseline that models the average patient, never seeing the individual's glucose data, has the lowest prediction accuracy of all six methods (RMSE: 63.6 mg/dL) but ranks treatments with the second-highest mean Spearman (0.766), while a black-box neural network that predicts glucose nearly twice as accurately (RMSE: 32.9 mg/dL) ranks them no better than a random ordering of the 20 treatments (0.049 Spearman). Therefore, selecting a DT based on prediction accuracy alone can prefer one that recommends treatments at chance, and decision quality must be evaluated directly rather than assumed to follow from prediction accuracy.

</details>


### [358] [Future of Time Series Anomaly Detection: From Historical Review to Unified Outlook](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30628)
*Zhijie Zhong,Zhiwen Yu,Pengyu Li,Liujian Zhang,Qiaoli Ni,Jiang Jun,Jianming Lv,Kaixiang Yang,C. L. Philip Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该综述针对时间序列异常检测（TSAD），系统梳理扩散模型、状态空间模型、大语言模型等新兴架构，提出细化的异常分类与现代范式taxonomy，深入分析评估方法并通过实验检验指标可靠性，同时发布开源基准库，最后指出动态阈值、可解释性、零样本迁移、多模态对齐与基础模型等开放挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据规模与应用复杂度上升推动TSAD出现扩散模型、状态空间模型、LLM等新架构，但现有综述对这些新兴设计的覆盖有限，且对多元异常、跨域统一建模、指标可靠性与当代评估挑战缺乏统一处理，因此需要一篇系统整合的综述来弥合理论与实践缺口。

Method: 综述性方法：建立细化的异常分类体系与反映现代进展的结构化范式taxonomy，比较各范式的检测机制并刻画其发展脉络；系统分析评估方法论，开展综合实验评估指标保真度（metric fidelity）；构建涵盖算法、数据集与评估工具的开源基准库。

Result: 提供三大核心贡献：(1) 细化异常分类与结构化范式taxonomy，跨范式比较检测机制并绘制发展轨迹；(2) 评估方法的深入分析及指标保真度的综合实验，并配套开源基准仓库（算法、数据集、评估工具）；(3) 梳理关键开放挑战并给出前瞻性视角。

Conclusion: 该综述通过弥补现有理论与实证局限，为TSAD研究与实践部署建立了一个连贯的框架，并为动态阈值、模型可解释性、零样本迁移、多模态对齐及时间序列基础模型等方向指明未来研究路径。

Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) is a foundational problem in data mining, aiming to identify observations that deviate significantly from nominal temporal patterns. Driven by escalating data volumes and application complexity, recent research has yielded diverse architectures, including diffusion models, state space models, and large language models (LLMs). However, existing surveys provide limited coverage of these emerging designs and lack a unified treatment of multivariate anomalies, cross-domain unified modeling, metric reliability, and contemporary evaluation challenges. To bridge these gaps, this survey delivers three core contributions: (1) We establish a refined anomaly categorization and a structured taxonomy of paradigms reflecting modern advances, comparing detection mechanisms and charting developmental trajectories across paradigms. (2) We provide an extensive analysis of evaluation methodologies and conduct comprehensive experiments to assess metric fidelity, complemented by an open-source benchmark repository encompassing algorithms, datasets, and evaluation tools. (3) We outline key open challenges, offering forward-looking perspectives on dynamic thresholding, model interpretability, zero-shot transfer, multi-modal alignment, and foundational models for time series. By addressing existing theoretical and empirical limitations, this survey establishes a coherent framework to guide future TSAD research and practical deployments.

</details>


### [359] [Interpreting Model Reasoning through Behavioral Counterfactuals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30630)
*Shawn Im,James Oldfield,Adel Bibi,Sharon Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于行为反事实的定位方法：训练模块编辑残差流以最小化固定回复在源提示与反事实提示下输出分布的KL散度，并利用其归因图定位对反事实行为因果重要的位置，用于分析提示干预如何影响模型思维链。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解模型形成思维链的内部过程很重要，但采样响应的方差使干预效应难以隔离、推理难以系统比较。

Method: 给定固定回复，构造源提示与其反事实目标提示；训练模块编辑残差流，使两者在该固定回复上的下一词分布KL散度最小；再对模块输出做归因以识别对反事实恢复因果重要的位置，并可视化编辑的下游效应，最后用激活修补检验假设。案例研究为Gemma-4-E4B-it与DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B。

Result: 匹配输出分布比标准激活重建目标更能恢复反事实行为；模块输出的归因可有效识别因果重要位置。案例中，未在言语上被承认的建议影响主要经由问题陈述与填充词（filler tokens）的表示中介，下游效应包括改变论证框架甚至最终答案。

Conclusion: 行为反事实分布匹配+归因可视化构成分析模型推理的可用接口，可生成并检验关于模型计算的假设，并揭示隐性建议对推理的因果作用路径。

Abstract: Faithfully understanding the internal process that occurs as models form their chain of thought is an important problem with the rise in model capabilities. However, this remains challenging due to the variance in sampled responses, making it difficult to isolate the effects of interventions and compare model reasoning systematically. We propose a method for localizing and analyzing how a given intervention affects the model's reasoning through behavioral counterfactuals: given a fixed response, how does introducing an intervention to the prompt change the next-token distributions? We train a module to edit the residual stream such that it minimizes the KL divergence between the output distributions for a fixed response under a source prompt and its counterfactual target prompt. We find that matching the output distributions recovers the counterfactual behavior more effectively than standard activation reconstruction objectives and validate that attribution of the trained module outputs is effective for identifying causally important locations for counterfactual recovery. The attribution maps and visualizations of the downstream effects of model edits provide an interface for generating hypotheses about the original model's computation, which can then be tested with activation patching. In a case study on Gemma-4-E4B-it and DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B, we investigate how a suggestion influences model reasoning even when it is not verbally acknowledged. Our analysis identifies representations at the question statement and filler tokens that mediate a substantial part of the suggestion's influence, with downstream effects such as changing the framing of the justification or even the final answer.

</details>


### [360] [RiboBridge: protein-conditioned de novo RNA binder structure design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30668)
*Zhou Zhang,Hanqun Cao,Minghao Sun,Odin Zhang,Yang Zhang,Pheng Ann Heng,Wujun Li,Tianfan Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RiboBridge，一个"结构优先"框架，将RNA构象生成与蛋白-RNA组装解耦，通过跨坐标系交互几何实现无需预设结合位点的RNA结合分子设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设计能结合目标蛋白结构的RNA分子需同时生成RNA构象及其结合复合物几何，且不应预设结合位点。现有方法将两个耦合过程置于统一表征中建模，使RNA构象生成与蛋白相对放置相互纠缠。

Method: RiboBridge先在蛋白表面提议多个候选RNA结合界面；在预训练RNA结构隐空间（RiboSphere）内生成规范RNA构象；再预测蛋白-RNA相互作用约束，桥接独立定义的RNA与蛋白坐标系；最后通过刚体放置将交互几何转化为几何一致的蛋白相对位姿。

Result: 在时间切分、序列过滤、冗余受控的124个蛋白-RNA复合物基准上，采用事后界面对应评估（原生信息仅在生成后用于在已生成候选口袋中筛选），RiboBridge取得最高fNAT与DockQ，以及最低的界面RMSD与配体RMSD。组件消融与分阶段诊断进一步刻画了RNA构象生成、交互预测与刚体放置的各自贡献，并识别出复合物恢复误差的主要来源。

Conclusion: 将RNA构象生成与蛋白-RNA组装解耦的结构优先策略是可行且有效的，交互几何作为桥梁可实现几何一致的相对位姿预测，分阶段诊断亦揭示了误差瓶颈所在。

Abstract: Designing RNA molecules that bind to target protein structures requires generating both an RNA conformation and its bound complex geometry, without assuming a predefined binding site. Existing approaches generally model these coupled processes within a unified representation, entangling RNA conformation generation with protein-relative placement. In this work, we introduce RiboBridge, a structure-first framework that separates RNA conformational generation from protein--RNA assembly through cross-frame interaction geometry. RiboBridge first proposes multiple candidate RNA-binding interfaces on the protein surface, generates canonical RNA conformations within a pretrained RNA structural latent space (RiboSphere), and then predicts protein--RNA interaction constraints to bridge the independently defined RNA and protein coordinate frames. The resulting interaction geometry is converted into a geometrically consistent protein-relative pose through rigid placement. We evaluate RiboBridge on a temporally split, sequence-filtered, and redundancy-controlled benchmark of 124 protein--RNA complexes. Under post-hoc interface-correspondence evaluation, where native information is used only after generation to select among already generated predicted-pocket candidates, RiboBridge achieves the highest fNAT and DockQ and the lowest interface and ligand RMSDs among compared methods. Component ablations and stage-wise diagnostics further characterize the contributions of RNA conformational generation, interaction prediction, and rigid placement, identifying the main sources of complex-recovery error.

</details>


### [361] [Learning Domain Trajectories with Flow Matching for Gradual Domain Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30685)
*Yubo Huang,Yushe Cao,Zixi Wang,Jingzehua Xu,Xin Lai,Xiongyu Hu,Shuai Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlowGDA将渐进域适应建模为表示空间统计流形上的连续传输，用时变速度场的flow matching替代离散分步与Min-Max对抗训练，并通过对偶传输与语义一致性约束抑制语义漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大分布偏移是域泛化与无监督适应的主要障碍。渐进域适应通过引入有序中间域缓解该问题，但现有方法多为离散、分步式，易累积误差，且依赖不稳定的Min-Max优化。

Method: 提出FlowGDA：在表示空间的统计流形上将渐进适应建模为连续传输，学习时变速度场以诱导平滑的域轨迹；采用仿真无关的回归目标替代对抗训练；将相邻域间的左到右传输与源锚定传输耦合，并加入语义一致性损失以防语义漂移；通过两阶段顺序优化方案稳定训练。

Result: 大量实验表明该方法优于现有最先进技术，验证了flow matching作为域适应有效替代方案的可行性。

Conclusion: 以连续flow matching取代离散分步与对抗式优化，可在保持语义一致的同时实现更平滑、更稳定的渐进域适应。

Abstract: Large distribution shifts remain a primary obstacle for domain generalization and unsupervised adaptation. Although gradual domain adaptation alleviates this difficulty by introducing ordered intermediate domains, most existing approaches still operate in a discrete, step-wise manner, which can accumulate errors and often relies on unstable Min--Max optimization. We propose \textbf{FlowGDA}, a flow-matching framework that models gradual adaptation as \emph{continuous} transport on a statistical manifold in a representation space. FlowGDA learns time-dependent velocity fields that induce smooth domain trajectories, using a simulation-free regression objective rather than adversarial training. To prevent semantic drift, we couple left-to-right transport between consecutive domains with a source-anchored transport and a semantic consistency loss, and we further stabilize learning via a two-stage sequential optimization scheme. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art techniques, validating flow matching as an effective alternative for domain adaptation.

</details>


### [362] [An Agent Architecture with Tools and Memory for Selective Correction of Wrist PPG Heart Rate Estimates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30688)
*Xu Wang,Shuhan Yi,Zhen Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种围绕固定心率估计器的智能体架构（工具+记忆），通过候选估计、收益/风险预测与独立风险门控决定保留/修正/拒绝，在四个公开数据集上将十估计器宏平均MAE最多降低44.5%，并完成端侧实时部署验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腕部PPG心率估计易受运动伪影影响，而降低平均误差的修正往往会恶化个别窗口；因此需要一种既能提升平均精度、又能量化并控制"修正收益与修正风险"的方法，同时兼顾覆盖率。

Method: 构建智能体架构：在固定心率估计器外围加入工具与记忆模块；利用脉搏、运动及有限历史证据生成候选估计，并预测各候选的收益与危害以指导选择；由独立风险门控决定对每个输出保留、修正或拒绝。模型在PPG-DaLiA上训练，冻结权重后在Wrist Exercise、GalaxyPPG、WildPPG上测试，采用十个估计器的宏平均评估；并实现实时采集、蓝牙接收与智能手机部署。此外对比数值修正与窗口选择对总误差降低的贡献。

Result: 四个数据集上宏平均MAE最多下降44.5%，GalaxyPPG降幅最大；有益修正使绝对误差降低、有害修正使其升高均超过1 bpm，两者在四数据集上的宏平均占比分别为16.06%–36.64%与1.68%–6.77%；在60%与80%目标覆盖率下，对相同接受窗口做数值修正比窗口选择对总误差降低的贡献更大；一名受试者四次原型记录的后台分析中，无额外拒绝情况下宏平均MAE由9.09降至4.45 bpm。

Conclusion: 在所评估条件下，该架构在提升平均精度的同时量化了修正的收益与风险，支撑兼顾误差、修正风险与覆盖率的可穿戴心率分析，并具备端侧实时部署可行性。

Abstract: Wrist photoplethysmography (PPG) heart rate estimates are vulnerable to motion artifacts, and corrections that reduce mean error can worsen individual windows. We propose an agent architecture with tools and memory around a fixed heart rate estimator. Pulse, motion, and limited historical evidence generate candidate estimates, whose predicted benefits and harms guide selection. An independent risk gate determines whether to retain, correct, or reject each output. We trained the architecture on PPG-DaLiA and tested it on Wrist Exercise, GalaxyPPG, and WildPPG with frozen weights. Across these four public datasets, mean absolute error (MAE), macro-averaged over ten estimators, decreased by up to 44.5%, with the largest reduction on GalaxyPPG. Beneficial and harmful corrections decreased and increased absolute error by more than 1 bpm, respectively. Their ten-estimator macro-averaged proportions ranged from 16.06% to 36.64% and from 1.68% to 6.77%, respectively, across the four datasets. At 60% and 80% target coverage, numerical correction on the same accepted windows contributed more to total error reduction than window selection. We implemented real-time wearable acquisition, Bluetooth reception, and smartphone deployment of a selected estimator and the framework. In backend analysis of four prototype recordings from one participant, ten-estimator macro-averaged MAE decreased from 9.09 to 4.45 bpm without additional rejection. Under the evaluated conditions, the architecture improved average accuracy while quantifying correction benefits and harms, supporting wearable heart rate analysis that considers error, correction risk, and coverage.

</details>


### [363] [Solvable models of learning to pursue a moving target](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30721)
*John J. Vastola,Kanaka Rajan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文构建连续时间线性二次的开环目标追踪模型，最优策略在"反应式追当前位置"与"预测式追未来位置"之间连续插值，并给出最优策略、策略学习与价值学习的闭式解；学习时间尺度对应矩阵特征值，特征谱存在间隙，说明智能体先学会"够得着"再优化"最优移动"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动物追踪行为观察显示存在两类极端策略：纯反应式趋向目标当前位置，或预测目标未来位置并直达。作者希望理解这类策略如何被学习得到，因此需要一个可控、可解释、可解析的理论模型来刻画策略谱系及其学习动力学。

Method: 提出连续时间线性二次（LQ）开环目标追踪模型；用少量可解释参数控制最优策略在反应式与预测式之间的位置；利用线性结构推导最优策略、策略学习动力学与价值学习动力学的闭式解；通过相关矩阵的特征值分析学习时间尺度，并分析特征值谱的间隙结构。

Result: 学习时间尺度精确对应特定矩阵的特征值；相关特征值谱普遍存在间隙（gap）；该间隙表明智能体先学会到达目标（追踪能力），之后才优化移动方式（路径/效率），即学习呈现分阶段的时间尺度分离。

Conclusion: 论文给出了追踪行为及其学习动力学的详细数学刻画，可作为实证研究的基准（benchmark），并为更复杂的追踪理论建模提供基础。

Abstract: Agents tasked with intercepting a moving target must learn how to reach it, ideally as efficiently as possible. As observers of animal pursuit behavior have noticed, different strategies are possible: on one extreme, the agent reactively moves toward the target's current location; on the other, the agent predicts the target's future location and moves directly there. Motivated by the desire to understand how such strategies might be learned, we introduce a continuous-time linear-quadratic model of open-loop target pursuit whose optimal control strategies interpolate between these possibilities. Usefully, a small number of interpretable parameters control which type of strategy is optimal, and it is possible to derive closed-form solutions for optimal strategies, policy learning dynamics, and value learning dynamics. Exploiting our model's linear structure, we find that the time scales of learning precisely correspond to the eigenvalues of certain matrices, and that relevant eigenvalue spectra generically have a gap. We show that this gap indicates that agents tend to learn how to reach their target before optimizing their movement. Our results provide a detailed mathematical characterization of pursuit behavior and its learning dynamics, which can both serve as a benchmark for empirical work, and as a foundation for more elaborate theoretical treatments of pursuit.

</details>


### [364] [Federated Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30728)
*Xiaobao Wang,Renda Han,Zhiliang Xia,Meng Liu,Renxiang Guan,Di Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FedGRAG，在多个持有本地知识图谱的客户端间实现联邦式图检索与知识增强生成，用联邦知识路由定位相关客户端、用受控披露的证据摘要实现跨端证据重构，性能优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GraphRAG依赖集中式知识图谱，而真实知识分散在多个组织，且隐私约束禁止共享完整本地知识图谱，导致无法统一检索与利用分布式知识。

Method: 针对两大挑战：（1）无全局图导致无法统一检索——提出联邦知识路由机制，借助轻量知识索引识别相关客户端而不暴露本地图结构；（2）本地图记忆含敏感实体与知识不能直接共享——提出受控披露证据构造方法，抽取检索到的证据子图并转换为证据摘要，在服务器端完成证据转换与重构。

Result: 大量实验表明，FedGRAG在检索任务与下游生成任务上均稳定优于现有基线。

Conclusion: FedGRAG为在联邦环境下部署GraphRAG提供了新范式，兼顾分布式检索效果与隐私保护。

Abstract: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) leverages centralized knowledge graphs to enhance large language models with structured knowledge retrieval. However, real-world knowledge is inherently distributed across multiple organizations rather than being centrally accessible. Privacy constraints further prohibit sharing entire local knowledge graphs, preventing GraphRAG from effectively retrieving and utilizing distributed knowledge. To this end, we propose Federated GraphRAG (FedGRAG), a unified framework for distributed graph retrieval and knowledge-enhanced generation over multiple clients with knowledge graphs. Specifically, we address two fundamental challenges in federated GraphRAG. First, the absence of a global knowledge graph makes unified retrieval impossible. To address this, we develop a Federated Knowledge Routing mechanism that efficiently identifies relevant clients through lightweight knowledge indices without exposing local graph structures. Second, local graph memory cannot be shared directly because it contains sensitive entities and knowledge information. We therefore propose a controlled-disclosure evidence construction method. It extracts retrieved evidence subgraphs and converts them into an evidence abstract, enabling evidence conversion and reconstruction on the server. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Federated GraphRAG consistently outperforms existing baselines in both retrieval and downstream generation tasks, establishing a new paradigm for deploying GraphRAG in federated environments.

</details>


### [365] [Width and Depth Limits Commute During Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30729)
*Ruijia Zhang,Soufiane Hayou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在 Depth-μP 分支缩放（1/√depth）与 μP 宽度参数化下，线性残差网络训练中宽度极限与深度极限可交换（对任意固定 GD 步数、带梯度裁剪）；无裁剪时一般仅有依概率收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作证明残差网络在初始化阶段、以 1/√depth 缩放时无限宽与无限深极限可交换；本文旨在把该交换性结论从初始化推广到训练动力学。

Method: 采用与初始化一致的 Depth-μP 分支缩放与 μP 宽度参数化，考虑线性残差网络；对固定数量的梯度下降步（含梯度裁剪）分析网络输出，在任意联合的宽度—深度增长路径上证明 L² 收敛；并对比无裁剪情形，使用依概率收敛刻画。

Result: 带梯度裁剪时，对任意固定训练步数，网络输出沿每条联合宽度—深度增长路径在 L² 意义下收敛，从而在任意有限训练时域内无限宽与无限深极限可交换；无梯度裁剪时，相应 L² 收敛一般不成立，但可得较弱的依概率收敛。

Conclusion: 交换性从初始化扩展到有限训练时域，其成立依赖于 Depth-μP 缩放、μP 参数化与梯度裁剪；梯度裁剪是保证 L²（即均方）收敛而非仅依概率收敛的关键条件。

Abstract: Recent work established that the infinite-width and infinite-depth limits of residual networks commute at initialization when residual branches are scaled by $1/\sqrt{depth}$. In particular, the network output converges to the same limit whether width and depth tend to infinity sequentially or jointly. We extend this commutativity result to training in linear residual networks. Under the same $1/\sqrt{depth}$ residual-branch scaling (Depth-$μ$P) and the $μ$P width parameterization, we prove that, for any fixed number of gradient-descent steps with gradient clipping, the network output converges in $L^2$ along every joint width--depth growth path as both width and depth tend to infinity. Consequently, the infinite-width and infinite-depth limits commute throughout any finite training horizon. Without gradient clipping, the corresponding $L^2$ convergence does not hold in general, but we establish the weaker convergence in probability.

</details>


### [366] [Random Remasking Scales Masked Diffusion Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30744)
*Zhaoyi Zhou,Frank Wu,Andrea Zanette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将掩码扩散模型(MDM)的推理重表述为干净序列空间上的马尔可夫链，提出免微调、免奖励的R²D推理与轨迹修正训练TCT，在逻辑任务上近对数线性扩展，Sudoku>97%、3-SAT>99%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MDM解码时引入的错误通常不可逆，已有迭代修正方法虽能提升样本质量，但缺乏在"学习到的、不完美去噪器"前提下的理论解释。

Method: 把MDM推理建模为干净序列空间上的马尔可夫链，其转移核为"重掩码-去噪"(remask-denoise)核：随机重新引入掩码再执行去噪，从而可分析朝向数据分布的真实去噪轨迹。由此导出Random Remask-Denoise (R²D)，一种纯测试时、免微调、免奖励的推理过程；并进一步提出Trajectory Correction Training (TCT)，在生成轨迹上让去噪器暴露于自身错误进行训练。

Result: 逻辑任务上呈现近乎对数线性的测试时扩展：困难数独准确率>97%，3-SAT>99%；在真实语言任务上对预训练模型同样有效，在HumanEval+上优于迭代修正基线和LLaDA2.1-mini官方Q-mode准确率。

Conclusion: 以remask-denoise核的马尔可夫链视角可刻画不完美去噪器下的MDM推理轨迹，据此得到的R²D与TCT在逻辑推理与代码生成任务上取得显著且可扩展的提升。

Abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate sequences by progressively unmasking tokens, but errors introduced during decoding are typically irreversible. Recent work has shown that iterative correction can improve sample quality, yet existing theory fails to explain this given a learned, imperfect denoiser model. We re-formulate MDM inference as a Markov chain on the clean sequence space, defined by a remask-denoise kernel that randomly re-introduces masks and then denoises. This helps us analyze the actual denoising trajectory towards the data distribution. The analysis motivates Random Remask-Denoise (R$^2$D) inference, a purely test-time, finetuning-free, reward-free procedure. To further improve performance, we propose Trajectory Correction Training (TCT), a denoiser-training procedure that exposes the model to its own errors along the generation trajectory. On logical tasks, our approach exhibits a striking near-log-linear test-time scaling, achieving over 97% accuracy on hard Sudoku puzzles and over 99% accuracy on 3-SAT. Our approach also applies to pretrained models on actual language tasks, beating iterative correction baselines and the official Q-mode accuracy of LLaDA2.1-mini on HumanEval+.

</details>


### [367] [Visualizing and Interpreting Temporal Care Team Dynamics for Cancer Survival Risk Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30748)
*Yuhua Huang,Hsiao-Ying Lu,Kwan-Liu Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个可视分析框架，基于EHR通信数据构建动态协作网络，用时序图神经网络(TGNN)估计肿瘤患者结局风险随时间的变化，并结合多视图交互系统、代理逻辑回归的特征级解释与what-if探索，帮助分析人员考察风险估计与医护协作模式的协同演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肿瘤诊疗是纵向、时间敏感的过程，需多学科医护人员持续协作；已有研究将医疗团队结构与患者结局关联，但协作的时间动态及其与患者风险演化的关系尚不清楚。

Method: 从EHR介导的通信数据构建动态协作网络；采用TGNN对患者结局风险进行随时间估计；分析团队构成与专科医生参与度的变化如何对应不同治疗阶段的风险变动；构建多视图交互系统，整合TGNN风险建模、协作网络协同可视化、代理逻辑回归的特征级解释及探索性what-if分析。

Result: 在505名乳腺癌、结直肠癌和肺癌患者的专家引导分析场景中验证了系统效用，展示了其揭示具有临床意义的协作模式的能力；系统不主张因果关系，而支持分析人员考察风险估计与协作模式的共同演化。

Conclusion: 该工作提升了时序图模型在纵向、团队式医疗场景中的可解释性，并可推广至其他演化型协作场景。

Abstract: Cancer care is a longitudinal, time-sensitive process requiring coordination among diverse healthcare professionals (HCPs), whose collaboration evolves throughout treatment. Prior studies link care team structure to patient outcomes, but the temporal dynamics of collaboration and their relationship to evolving patient risk remain poorly understood. We introduce a visual analytics framework for modeling and interpreting time-varying care team interactions in oncology. We construct dynamic collaboration networks from electronic health record (EHR)-mediated communication data and use a temporal graph neural network (TGNN) to estimate patient outcome risk over time. We then investigate how changes in care team composition and specialist participation relate to shifts in estimated risk across treatment stages. Our multi-view interactive system combines TGNN-based risk modeling with coordinated visualizations of care team networks, feature-level explanations from a surrogate logistic regression model, and exploratory what-if analysis. Without making causal claims, the system helps analysts examine how risk estimates co-evolve with collaboration patterns and identify care team characteristics associated with these changes. We demonstrate its utility through expert-guided analysis scenarios involving 505 patients with breast, colorectal, and lung cancers, evaluating its ability to reveal clinically meaningful collaboration patterns. This work improves the interpretability of temporal graph-based models in longitudinal, team-based healthcare, with potential applicability to other evolving collaborative settings.

</details>


### [368] [Primal-Dual Representation Learning for Low-Rank Constrained MDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30756)
*Chenhao Zhou,Chao Zhang,Wensong Bai,Hanbin Zhao,Hui Qian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文首次为低秩、连续状态约束MDP提出有理论保证的表示学习方法：REP-PD-TEG（软累计违约）与REP-PD-H-TEG（硬累计违约），分别给出回归与违约界，其中REP-PD-TEG达到最优Õ(√K)回报界，探索成本计入时总体样本界为Õ(K^{3/4})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表示学习已显著提升无约束连续状态MDP的效率，但扩展到约束MDP（CMDP）困难：转移表示的学习必须与约束违约控制同时进行，二者相互耦合，缺乏理论保证的方法。

Method: 针对连续状态低秩CMDP：1）REP-PD-TEG（软累计违约）：特征学习阶段用衰减ε-greedy混合执行策略交互，样本通过极大似然学习转移特征；基于学习到的特征构造不确定性bonus，以乐观拉格朗日目标规划得到回报策略；并量化衰减ε-greedy探索的影响。2）REP-PD-H-TEG（硬累计违约，需逐episode验证可行性）：在学习表示下依据bonus修正的下置信效用证书规划，并采用稳定化对偶搜索获得回报策略。

Result: 证明了REP-PD-TEG回报策略的回归界与软违约界，REP-PD-TEG达到最优Õ(√K)回报策略界，探索动作计入成本时总体样本界为Õ(K^{3/4})；REP-PD-H-TEG给出回归界与硬违约界。

Conclusion: 给出了首个同时具备软累计违约保证与经验证的硬违约控制的低秩连续状态CMDP表示学习方法，兼具理论保证与可行性认证。

Abstract: Representation learning has substantially improved the efficiency of unconstrained continuous-state Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), but its extension to Constrained MDPs (CMDPs) is difficult because the transition representation must be learned while constraint violation is controlled. In this paper, we study representation learning for low-rank CMDPs with continuous state spaces, and propose REP-PD-TEG for the soft cumulative-violation setting. In the feature learning period, the algorithm interacts with the environment using a decaying-$ε$-greedy mixture execution policy, and uses the collected samples to learn transition features by maximum likelihood. Based on the learned features, it constructs uncertainty bonuses and plans with an optimistic Lagrangian objective to obtain the return policy. We prove regret and soft-violation guarantees for the return policies, and quantify the influence of the decaying-$ε$-greedy exploration. In particular, REP-PD-TEG achieves the optimal $\widetilde O(\sqrt K)$ return policy bound, and gives a $\widetilde O(K^{3/4})$ overall sample bound when exploratory actions are charged. For the stricter hard cumulative violation, where feasibility must be verified episode by episode, we propose REP-PD-H-TEG. It plans under a bonus-corrected lower-confidence utility certificate with the learned representation, and performs a stabilized dual search to obtain the return policy, yielding regret and hard-violation bounds. Together, these results give the first theoretically guaranteed representation-learning method for low-rank continuous-state CMDPs with both soft cumulative guarantees and certified hard-violation control.

</details>


### [369] [Adaptive Deadline- and Energy-Aware Caching Algorithms in Dynamic Multi-UAV Edge Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30768)
*Jian Kim,Ki-Il Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 面向UAV内容缓存，联合优化截止期错失、通信能耗与能耗均衡：先给出可解释规则基线DE-UBAC，再提出GRU-DEPPO（局部/全局GRU+集中式PPO），截止期错失率降约61%、能耗不均衡降约40%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地面基础设施不可用或受扰时需借助无人机(UAV)维持内容分发，但现有缓存方法多只关注缓存命中率或平均时延，未联合处理空间异质且时变的需求、内容相关截止期以及UAV间不均衡的通信能耗。

Method: 将问题建模为动态的截止期与能量感知缓存放置与替换问题，联合考虑截止期错失、UAV侧通信能耗与UAV间能耗不均衡。先提出可解释的分层规则方案DE-UBAC（含截止期感知优先级、协同放置、能量感知协调与缓存更新代价）；再提出GRU-DEPPO，用局部与全局GRU时序表征结合集中式PPO actor-critic实现自适应放置与替换。

Result: 仿真表明GRU-DEPPO在所比较方案中取得最低截止期错失率与最低UAV侧通信总能耗；相对DE-UBAC，截止期错失率降低约61%，UAV间能耗不均衡降低约40%。

Conclusion: 规则方法受预定义优先级与阈值限制、适应性不足，而GRU辅助的集中式PPO能在动态耦合网络条件下同时改善时效性与能耗均衡，验证了学习型时序表征用于UAV缓存调度的有效性。

Abstract: Content caching via unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) becomes one of the solutions to maintain content delivery when terrestrial infrastructure is unavailable or disrupted. However, existing caching approaches often focus primarily on cache-hit performance or average delivery delay, without jointly addressing spatially heterogeneous and time-varying demand, content-specific deadlines, and uneven communication-energy consumption across UAVs. To address these challenges, we formulate a dynamic deadline- and energy-aware cache placement and replacement problem that jointly considers deadline misses, UAV-side communication energy, and inter-UAV energy imbalance. To achieve this, we first develop deadline- and energy-aware UBAC (DE-UBAC), an interpretable hierarchical rule-based realization that incorporates deadline-aware prioritization, cooperative placement, energy-aware coordination, and cache-update cost. However, predefined priorities and thresholds limit its adaptability under dynamically coupled network conditions. We therefore propose GRU-assisted Deadline- and Energy-aware Proximal Policy Optimization (GRU-DEPPO), which combines local and global GRU-based temporal representations with a centralized PPO actor-critic for adaptive cache placement and replacement. Simulation results show that GRU-DEPPO achieves the lowest deadline-miss rate and total UAV-side communication energy among the considered schemes. Compared with DE-UBAC, GRU-DEPPO reduces the deadline-miss rate by approximately 61% and inter-UAV energy imbalance by approximately 40%.

</details>


### [370] [One Pretrained Decision Model Is Enough for Training-Free Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30777)
*Xinyu Zhao,Qingyun Sun,Ziwei Zhang,Tianchen Zhu,Daqing Li,Jianxin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Jev-GAD 是一种免训练、可泛化的图异常检测框架：将互补的结构/属性/邻域证据转为图相对百分位，用冻结的预训练语言模型做选项 logit 读出的语义决策，并与四个统计分数等权秩融合。七基准平均 AUROC 89.18%、AUPRC 52.40%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图异常检测面临异构异常模式与跨图分布差异，难以泛化。现有免训练方法虽避免任务特定优化，但依赖预定义数值打分规则，未挖掘异构异常证据的语义解释能力。

Method: (1) 构建结构、属性、邻域三类互补证据，并将异构统计量转换为图相对异常百分位；(2) 设计语义 Graph-to-State (G2S) 变换，把图上下文与语义标注的节点证据组织为结构化决策状态；(3) 使用单个冻结预训练语言模型进行证据条件化的非生成式选项 logit 读出，得到决策分数；(4) 与四个统计分数做等权秩融合，全程无 GAD 特定梯度优化。

Result: 在引文、社交、共同评审三类共七个 GAD 基准上验证有效性，平均 AUROC 89.18%、AUPRC 52.40%；消融分析证实预训练决策读出与语义证据锚定的贡献。

Conclusion: 将数值异常证据语义化并交由冻结预训练模型决策，可在免训练条件下实现强泛化的图异常检测，为跨图通用 GAD 提供了新范式。

Abstract: Graph anomaly detection (GAD) aims to identify irregular entities in graph-structured data, yet heterogeneous anomaly patterns and distributional differences across graphs challenge generalizable detection. Existing training-free approaches avoid task-specific optimization but primarily rely on predefined numerical scoring rules, leaving the semantic interpretation of heterogeneous anomaly evidence largely unexplored. In this paper, we propose Jev-GAD, a training-free generalist graph anomaly detection framework that bridges heterogeneous numerical evidence and pretrained decision mechanisms. To address heterogeneous anomaly patterns, we construct complementary structural, attribute, and neighborhood evidence and transform heterogeneous statistics into graph-relative anomaly percentiles. To move beyond predefined numerical scoring rules, we leverage a single frozen pretrained language model for evidence-conditioned anomaly assessment. To bridge the semantic gap between numerical evidence and pretrained models, we design a semantic Graph-to-State (G2S) transformation that organizes graph context and semantically labeled node evidence into structured decision states for non-generative option-logit readout. The resulting decision scores are integrated with four complementary statistical scores through equal-weight rank-based fusion, without GAD-specific gradient-based optimization. Extensive experiments on seven graph anomaly detection benchmarks spanning citation, social, and co-review networks demonstrate the effectiveness of Jev-GAD, achieving average AUROC and AUPRC scores of 89.18\% and 52.40\%, respectively. Further analyses validate the contributions of pretrained decision readout and semantic evidence grounding.

</details>


### [371] [Gandalf: Flash Shall Not Die! Increasing Flash Storage Lifetime for KV Cache Offloading in LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30791)
*Maharani A. P. Irawan,Kuntai Du,Jiayi Yao,Dongjoo Seo,Yuyang Huang,Haryadi S. Gunawi,Junchen Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Gandalf 是首个具备 SSD 寿命感知的 KV cache 卸载系统，利用注意力类型等应用层信息对 KV cache 写入准入进行分级，在几乎不损失命中率的前提下将 SSD 寿命平均延长 7.3 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产级 LLM 负载（多轮对话、LLM 智能体）的 KV cache 写入总量远超 SSD 容量，使 SSD 寿命由数年缩短至数月。直观方案是按历史访问模式对写入做门控以减少写放大，但不同注意力类型产生的 KV cache 可能具有相同的历史访问模式而未来访问模式不同，导致命中率显著下降、服务成本上升。

Method: 核心洞察是：在不损害命中率的前提下降低写入，需同时考虑访问模式与注意力类型等应用层信息。据此提出 Gandalf，对写入 SSD 的 KV cache 按注意力类型分级准入，优先接纳 full-attention 的 KV cache，而非其他注意力类型（如滑动窗口/稀疏注意力）产生的缓存，从而在不牺牲命中率的条件下削减无效写入。

Result: 在多种负载 trace 及广泛硬件容量配置下，Gandalf 平均将 SSD 寿命延长 7.3 倍，且对 cache 命中率的影响可忽略。该设计还可推广至 HBF 等其他基于闪存的存储。

Conclusion: 将应用层语义（注意力类型）引入 KV cache 卸载的写准入策略，可有效解耦"减少写入"与"保持命中率"这一矛盾，为 SSD 上的 LLM KV cache 扩展提供寿命友好的方案，并具备向新型闪存介质迁移的通用性。

Abstract: KV caching reduces the serving cost of large language models (LLMs), but the growing KV cache footprint is increasingly exceeds GPU and host-memory capacity. Therefore, people use SSD to expand the KV cache storage capacity with high I/O bandwidth. However, in production LLM workload, such as multi-round conversation and LLM agents, the total amount of KV cache writes significantly exceeds SSD capacity, shortening SSD lifetime from years to months. To improve SSD lifetime, a natural solution is to reduce the KV cache writes by gating the KV cache writes via historical access patterns. However, that significantly lowers the KV cache hit rate (and increase the LLM serving cost) since KV caches from different attention types might have identical historical access pattern but different future access patterns. Our insight is that, to reduce KV cache writes without hurting KV cache hit rate, one need to not only consider the access pattern, but also application-level information such as the attention type of KV cache. Leveraging this observation, we propose Gandalf , the first SSD KV cache offloading system with SSD life time awareness. Gandalf prioritize the admission of full-attention KV cache into SSD over the cache generated by other types of attention, which significantly increases SSD lifetime without sacrificing cache hit rate. Our evaluation shows that Gandalf extends the SSD lifetime by 7.3X on average, while having negligible impact on cache hit rate across multiple workload traces and wide range of hardware capacity. Gandalf design can be extended to other flash-based storage, such as High Bandwidth Flash (HBF).

</details>


### [372] [Trace2World: Reconstructing App Worlds from Real Interaction Traces for Scalable GUI Agent Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30792)
*Zezhou Wang,Hanzhang Zhou,Panrong Tong,Quyu Kong,Pengxiang Li,Steven Hoi,Zhuzhong Qian,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Trace2World将GUI环境的"全局行为重建"与"实现编译"解耦：先把部分轨迹对齐为可溯源的共享应用模型，再编译为可执行环境，并用源工作流独立回放定位失配以做有界修复。从1,570条轨迹构建50个环境，200个工作流端到端复现率达91.1%（基线59.8%）；源校验保留真实设备94.0%训练增益，模型在自有基准提升20.2点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩展GUI强化学习需要能保持真实应用行为的可交互环境。已有做法把"行为推断"与"编码实现"耦合在一起，导致从部分轨迹生成的mock环境出现错误的状态转移，行为保真度不足；同时缺乏区分"源证据是否支持某行为"与"实现是否正确"的判定手段。

Method: 提出Trace2World两阶段框架：(1)行为重建——将轨迹调和(reconcile)为统一的、与源轨迹链接(source-linked)的应用模型；(2)实现编译——由该模型编译出可执行环境。通过独立回放源工作流来定位不匹配处，进行有界(bounded)实现修复。对通过校验的世界，在源证据支持的行为范围内做面向学习者的自适应任务与环境增强(learner-adaptive augmentation)。

Result: 从1,570条轨迹构建50个环境；10个应用、200个工作流上端到端复现91.1%，最强任务局部基线为59.8%。源 grounding 校验在真实设备上保留94.0%的模拟训练增益，自校验仅54.7%。学习者引导使基准成功率由56.9%升至61.1%。在Trace2World中训练使模型在自建基准提升20.2点，四个外部GUI基准提升5.4–16.2点，100个真实设备任务提升16.3点。

Conclusion: 可靠的重建应把"源证据支持何种行为"与"实现是否保真"加以分离；解耦式重建配合源链接校验显著提升了环境保真度、模拟到真实的迁移效率与下游RL训练效果。

Abstract: Scaling GUI reinforcement learning requires environments that preserve real-app behavior. Yet coupling behavior inference with coding can turn partial traces into runnable mocks with incorrect state transitions. We introduce \textbf{Trace2World}, which separates global behavior reconstruction from implementation. It reconciles traces into a shared, source-linked app model, then compiles an executable environment. Independent replay of source workflows localizes mismatches for bounded implementation repair. Validated worlds then support learner-adaptive task and environment augmentation within source-supported behavior. From 1,570 traces, Trace2World constructs 50 environments. On 200 workflows across ten apps, 91.1% are reproduced end to end, versus 59.8% for the strongest matched task-local baseline. Source-grounded validation retains 94.0% of simulated training gains on real devices, versus 54.7% under self-validation. Learner guidance raises benchmark success from 56.9% to 61.1%. Training in Trace2World further improves the model by 20.2 points on our benchmark, 5.4--16.2 points across four external GUI benchmarks, and 16.3 points on 100 real-device tasks. Reliable reconstruction separates what behavior source evidence supports from whether the implementation preserves it.

</details>


### [373] [GIFT: Gradient Informed Filtering for Distillation Augmented Reasoning RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30796)
*Shijie Li,Yilin Gao,Tieyuan Chen,Yun Luo,Weiyao Lin,Hang Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 GIFT 方法，通过对蒸馏梯度与 RL 梯度的几何分解（平行/正交分量）对 token 级教师信号打分过滤，并配合覆盖率退火调度，实现蒸馏与结果导向 RL 的兼容优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏结果导向 RL 提供正确性信号，稠密 token 级蒸馏提供指导，但二者在优化目标上可能冲突：模仿式蒸馏与结果驱动 RL 目标不一致，现有混合方法缺乏有原则的冲突消解机制。

Method: GIFT 进行 token 级梯度几何分析：将蒸馏梯度分解为与 RL 梯度平行的分量（衡量一阶冲突，作为安全性过滤）和正交分量（衡量新颖方向指导，作为价值度量），据此构建打分规则对 token 级指导排序；并结合渐进式 coverage annealing 调度，逐步收缩接受蒸馏的 token 预算，优先丢弃高冲突更新、保留高互补更新，使训练从稠密几何过滤指导平滑过渡到纯结果导向目标。

Result: 在数学与逻辑推理基准上，GIFT 在多种模型规模下稳定优于强基线，困难数学推理任务相对提升最高达 9.5%。

Conclusion: 监督信号的互补性不等于优化兼容性；基于梯度的几何筛选加退火调度可原则性地分配蒸馏更新，实现蒸馏增强推理 RL 的有效融合。

Abstract: Training large language models for complex reasoning tasks relies on two complementary signals: sparse, outcome-grounded reinforcement learning (RL) for correctness, and dense, token-level distillation for guidance. However, complementarity in supervision does not guarantee compatibility in optimization; imitation-focused distillation can conflict with the outcome-driven RL objective, and existing hybrids lack a principled resolution. We propose \textbf{GIFT} (\textbf{G}radient-\textbf{I}nformed \textbf{F}il\textbf{T}ering for Distillation-Augmented Reasoning RL), a novel method that directly addresses the allocation problem of which teacher updates to apply. GIFT performs a token-level geometric analysis, decomposing the distillation gradient into a component \textbf{parallel} to the RL gradient, which measures first-order conflict and provides a \textbf{safety} filter, and a component \textbf{orthogonal} to it, which quantifies novel directional guidance and provides a measure of \textbf{value}. This decomposition yields a principled scoring rule to rank token-level guidance. We combine this with a progressive \textbf{coverage annealing} schedule that shrinks the budget of tokens receiving distillation, ensuring that the most conflicting updates are discarded first while the most complementary ones are retained at full strength. This facilitates a smooth transition from dense, geometrically-filtered guidance to a pure, outcome-grounded objective at convergence. Extensive experiments on mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks show that GIFT consistently outperforms strong baselines across multiple model scales, achieving relative gains of up to 9.5\% on difficult mathematical reasoning tasks. Code: https://github.com/lilifree/GIFT

</details>


### [374] [A Computationally Efficient and Rate-Optimal Algorithm for Adversarial Linear MDPs with (Aggregate) Bandit Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30801)
*Haolin Liu,Chen-Yu Wei,Hanbin Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究转移未知、损失对抗、带反馈的episode线性MDP，首次给出多项式时间且达到$\sqrt{K}$ regret的算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有最好结果（Liu et al., 2024）要么计算低效但达到$\sqrt{K}$ regret，要么多项式时间但只有次优的$K^{3/4}$ regret。作者希望同时实现计算高效与最优遗憾界。

Method: 将对抗线性MDP归约为对抗线性bandit，其动作集为策略的期望特征向量；该动作集未知、只能通过探索估计。作者构造近似分离预言机（approximate separation oracle），要么从查询特征生成可执行策略，要么精化动作集的外近似；思路借鉴van Erven et al. (2025)对线性上下文bandit的归约和Ito et al. (2019)的oracle高效线性bandit算法，并额外处理预言机的不精确性。

Result: 得到首个多项式时间、$\sqrt{K}$ regret的算法，且算法仅需聚合损失反馈（aggregate loss feedback）。

Conclusion: 这是（据作者所知）首个适用于表格情形之外、带聚合反馈的对抗MDP的多项式时间算法。

Abstract: We study episodic linear Markov decision processes with unknown transitions, adversarial losses, and bandit feedback. The state-of-the-art result for this setting (Liu et al., 2024) either achieves $\sqrt{K}$ regret with a computationally inefficient algorithm or achieves suboptimal $K^{3/4}$ regret, where $K$ is the number of episodes. Our work gives the first $\sqrt{K}$ regret with a polynomial-time algorithm. Our method reduces adversarial linear MDPs to adversarial linear bandits whose action set consists of policies' expected feature vectors. The central challenge is that this action set is unknown and can be estimated only through exploration. We address this challenge by constructing an approximate separation oracle for the action set that either generates executable policies from queried features, or refines an outer approximation of the action set. This approach draws inspiration from the reduction of van Erven et al. (2025) for linear contextual bandits and the oracle-efficient linear bandit algorithm of Ito et al. (2019), but additionally deals with the imprecision of the oracle. The resulting algorithm requires only aggregate loss feedback, and to our knowledge. This is the first polynomial-time algorithm for adversarial MDPs with aggregate feedback beyond the tabular case.

</details>


### [375] [Is spectral predictability enough? Testing Ω-matching for synthetic pretraining under distribution shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30802)
*Edric Castel C. Hao,Juan Raphael S. Seña,Neon S. De Jesus*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文检验"可预测性感知预训练"假设：仅用谱可预测性 Ω 匹配合成源与真实目标是否足以指导合成数据的选用。结论是不充分——Ω 匹配在受控的合成-合成条件下有效，但在真实基准 ETTm1 上几乎不能预测迁移收益方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布偏移下的合成预训练需要选择"用哪一类合成数据"。一个直观准则是将源数据的谱可预测性 Ω 与目标对齐，但 Ω 是否构成充分准则尚未被系统检验。

Method: 在三种架构（LSTM、PatchTST、TCN）与三个随机种子上做对照实验：(1) 理想合成-合成设定下检验 Ω 匹配预训练能否超越 oracle 基线；(2) 在真实 ETTm1 基准上使用正弦加噪数据与混沌 ODE 轨迹两类源，均按 Ω 匹配，比较迁移效果；(3) 用跨源方向一致率与 Pearson 相关系数量化 Ω 对"哪个源有益"的预测能力，并考察 Ω 差距方向引起的架构相关不对称性。

Result: 合成-合成条件下 Ω 匹配可超过 oracle 基线（LSTM 上 MSE 降低 +46.8%），但收益已依赖架构；ETTm1 上正弦加噪匹配 Ω 仅带来 +2.3% 平均提升（个别通道最高 +65.5%），而匹配 Ω 的混沌 ODE 轨迹系统性劣化 -13.2%；两类源在三种架构所有配置上对迁移方向的判断仅 53% 一致（Pearson r=-0.02），说明 Ω 几乎不携带"何种源可有益迁移"的信息。此外观察到对 Ω 差距方向的响应存在架构相关的不对称性。

Conclusion: Ω 匹配在受控环境中有帮助，但不足以预测跨源迁移，不宜单独作为源选择准则；后续源选择准则需纳入更多信号性质（如谱结构细节、噪声特性、动力学复杂度等）。

Abstract: Synthetic pretraining under distribution shift requires deciding what synthetic data to use. A natural criterion is to match the spectral predictability $Ω$ of the source to the target, but is $Ω$ sufficient? We test this hypothesis, which we call predictability-aware pretraining, across three architectures (LSTM, PatchTST, TCN) and three seeds. Under ideal synthetic-to-synthetic conditions, $Ω$-matched pretraining can outperform even an oracle baseline (+46.8% MSE reduction, LSTM), though the benefit is already architecture-dependent. On the real-world ETTm1 benchmark, however, this relationship does not hold: sine-plus-noise pretraining at matched $Ω$ yields only a marginal mean improvement +2.3% averaged over all three architectures, up to +65.5% on individual channels), whereas $Ω$ matched chaotic ODE trajectories systematically degrade performance -13.2%). The two sources agree on the direction of transfer for only 53% of configurations across all three architectures (Pearson r=-0.02), indicating that $Ω$ carries little information about which source will transfer beneficially. We further observe an architecture-dependent asymmetry in the response to the direction of the $Ω$ gap. We conclude that $Ω$ matching can help in controlled settings but is not sufficient to predict transfer across sources, and we discuss additional signal properties that a source-selection criterion may need to consider.

</details>


### [376] [Neural Spectral Capacity with Residual Context for Heterogeneous Resource Allocation within Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30823)
*Chenyu Zhu,Ruoyu Zhao,Zhichao Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出残差感知神经谱容量（ResNSC）及其分配器 ResNSC-DP，从架构规格无数据地预测 Transformer 相对训练性能，并在预训练与 LLaMA-7B 剪枝中优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练成本高昂，使得基于架构规格预测相对训练性能成为指导设计的关键手段。现有 Neural Spectral Capacity (NSC) 对每个投影独立打分，对同一层配置的"兼容重排"给出相同分数，无法反映残差流中位置相关的累积更新效应。

Method: 面向 Transformer 引入 ResNSC：利用由规格推导的累积残差更新统计参考，确定每个投影容量计算中的输入与残差状态统计量，保持无需数据、无需实例化权重的加性评估。因残差宽度可变导致早期选择影响后续打分，将 NSC-DP 分配器的状态由"层-预算"扩展为包含残差历史；ResNSC-DP 在资源预算下联合分配残差宽度与前馈宽度，并对给定有限候选集内最优数值评估 ResNSC 分数给出可证界（certified bounds）。

Result: 在 121M 与 374M 预训练规模下，所选架构在 FineWeb-Edu、WikiText-2、LAMBADA 上以相当参数预算取得低于均匀、变宽与锥形分配的困惑度；在 LoNAS 超网继承权重的 LLaMA-7B 剪枝中，ResNSC-DP 在八个匹配参数预算下将八任务平均准确率较 NSC 提升 3.28–5.46 个百分点。配对反转实验保持投影形状与 NSC 分数不变却使两种设置下性能变差，揭示了位置无关打分所掩盖的性能差异。

Conclusion: 位置相关的残差统计对容量预测至关重要；ResNSC 与 ResNSC-DP 在预训练宽度分配和继承权重剪枝两类场景均验证有效，代码已开源。

Abstract: Predicting relative trained performance from architectural specifications can guide design when training costs limit experimentation. Neural Spectral Capacity (NSC) provides such a heuristic, but scores projections independently and assigns identical scores to compatible reorderings of the same layer configurations. We introduce Residual-Aware Neural Spectral Capacity (ResNSC) for Transformers, using a specification-derived statistical reference for accumulated residual updates to determine the input and residual-state statistics in each projection's capacity calculation, while retaining additive evaluation without data or instantiated weights. When residual widths vary, earlier choices affect later scores, so we augment NSC's allocator (NSC-DP) with residual history beyond its layer-and-budget state. ResNSC-DP jointly allocates residual and feed-forward widths under a resource budget, with certified bounds on the best numerically evaluated ResNSC score within a specified finite candidate set. At the 121M and 374M pretraining scales, selected architectures achieve lower mean perplexity than uniform, variable-width, and tapered allocations on FineWeb-Edu, WikiText-2, and LAMBADA at comparable parameter budgets. In inherited-weight LLaMA-7B pruning using the LoNAS supernet, ResNSC-DP improves eight-task average accuracy over NSC by 3.28--5.46 percentage points across eight matched parameter budgets. Paired reversals preserve the projection shapes and NSC scores yet worsen performance in both settings, exposing performance differences hidden by position-independent scoring. The code for this work is available at https://github.com/Optima-CityU/neural-spectral-capacity.

</details>


### [377] [Lean Finder V2: Semantic Search for Mathlib That Disambiguates User Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30843)
*Jialin Lu,Xiaoyu Liu,Hengrui Luo,Rodrigo Stehling,Linxi Liu,Weiran Sun,Yuepeng Wang,Wuyang Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Lean Finder V2 是一个面向 Mathlib 的语义检索框架，通过模型级对抗训练与输入级查询重写相结合来消解用户的简短模糊查询，在 MathlibQR 基准上取得 SOTA，并在真实交互与下游定理证明中验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实场景中数学家与编码智能体检索 Mathlib 时往往只给简短性质、记号、别名或假设，大量数学意图隐含未言明；而现有 Mathlib 检索引擎不现实地假设查询上下文丰富。同时，真实短查询与标准答案配对的稀缺使歧义问题更难处理。作者认为这本质是数据问题。

Method: 以对抗训练规模化生成带标注的简短歧义查询，从模型级微调（model-level adversarial training）与输入级查询重写（query rewriting）两个互补层面学习消歧；在 SOTA 检索器之上进一步优化查询重写。

Result: 在人工标注的 MathlibQR 基准上相对此前最佳 Mathlib 语义检索引擎至少提升 11%（相对值）；查询重写在 SOTA 检索器基础上进一步提升检索效果；在来自人类与编码智能体的无标注查询上被评为最强系统；集成到 Claude Code 后提升了定理证明任务的下游证明成功率。

Conclusion: 将 Mathlib 短查询歧义问题视为数据问题并以对抗训练扩充监督信号，配合模型级与输入级双重消歧，可显著提升语义检索性能并迁移到真实工作流与下游证明任务，系统已开源。

Abstract: We introduce Lean Finder V2, a semantic search framework for Mathlib that disambiguates user queries through complementary model-level adversarial training and input-level query rewriting. Human mathematicians and coding agents rarely search Mathlib by providing detailed context. In practice, they query short properties, notation, aliases, or hypotheses, leaving much of the intended mathematics implicit. In contrast, existing Mathlib search engines unrealistically assume context-rich queries. The scarcity of real-world short queries paired with ground-truth Mathlib statements makes this ambiguity even more intractable. We argue that this is essentially a data problem. Through adversarial training, we scale up the generation of labeled short and ambiguous queries, and learn to disambiguate user queries at both model-level fine-tuning and input-level query rewriting. On the human-curated MathlibQR benchmark, our Lean Finder V2 sets a new state of the art, with at least 11% relative improvement over the previous best Mathlib semantic search engines. On top of our state-of-the-art retriever, optimized query rewriting further improves MathlibQR retrieval. On unlabeled queries from human and coding-agent interactions, Lean Finder V2 is ranked as the strongest system. Integrated with Claude Code, Lean Finder V2 improves proof success on downstream theorem-proving task. Lean Finder V2 is available at: https://leanfinder.github.io/

</details>


### [378] [Reverse-KL Policy Distillation: Statistical Guarantees and Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30844)
*Haolin Liu,Chen-Yu Wei,Julian Zimmert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次从理论上研究 reverse-KL 蒸馏的样本复杂度，对比在线/离线蒸馏及两种教师反馈模型（完整分布 vs. 单点概率），给出极小极大上下界并提出可达最优保证的算法技术。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: reverse-KL 蒸馏在训练语言模型上经验有效，但其统计保证与极限尚不清楚；尤其两个设计选择的影响未知：(1) 教师给出完整动作分布是否优于仅给出对采样动作的概率；(2) 训练轨迹必须来自学生（在线）还是教师生成轨迹（离线）即可。

Method: 研究在线 reverse-KL 蒸馏在两种反馈模型下的样本复杂度，建立极小极大下界与上界；对比离线情形；证明常见在线目标（仅在历史学生轨迹上评估候选）会失效；提出 trajectory-loss、importance-ratio truncation 截断技术结合 policy-space learning 实现最优在线保证。

Result: 在线情形：完整分布反馈的极小极大界被建立，仅观测学生动作概率时可能需要显著更多数据。离线情形：无论教师揭示完整分布还是仅揭示教师生成动作的概率，均可达到相同极小极大速率。关键区别在于教师生成的动作本身会揭示其偏好，而在学生选择的动作处查询可能使这些偏好未被观测。

Conclusion: 在线蒸馏相比离线蒸馏存在额外的统计挑战；这些保证无法简单通过优化标准蒸馏目标获得；所提 trajectory-loss、importance-ratio truncation 与 policy-space learning 技术可实现最优的在线蒸馏保证。

Abstract: Reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation has shown empirical promise for training language models, but its statistical guarantees and limits remain poorly understood. In particular, the effects of two design choices remain unclear: Does access to the teacher's full action distribution provide an advantage over observing only the probability it assigns to the sampled action? Must training trajectories come from the student (online distillation), or can teacher-generated trajectories (offline distillation) suffice? Our work takes a first step toward understanding the theory underlying these questions.
  We study the sample complexity of online reverse-KL distillation under two feedback models: the teacher reveals either its full action distribution or only the probability of the student-generated action. We establish minimax bounds for the former and show that substantially more data may be required for the latter. In contrast, offline reverse-KL distillation can attain the same minimax rate whether the teacher reveals its full distribution or only its probability of the teacher-generated action. The key distinction is that teacher-generated actions themselves reveal the teacher's preferences, while queries at student-selected actions can leave those preferences unobserved. This highlights an additional statistical challenge for online distillation compared to offline distillation.
  These statistical guarantees do not follow simply from optimizing standard distillation objectives: our lower bounds show that common online objectives can fail when candidates are evaluated only on past student-generated trajectories. We develop trajectory-loss and importance-ratio truncation techniques together with policy-space learning to achieve optimal online distillation guarantees.

</details>


### [379] [Bifurcations from Weight Space: JEPAWG on Parametric Dynamical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30847)
*Tobias Göbel,Miranda C. N. Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文以四类动力系统构建按物理参数索引的“模型动物园”，检验联合嵌入超网络JEPAWG：其潜空间/权重几何可定位Hopf分岔与曲线、追踪倍周期级联并粗略估计Feigenbaum常数、并检测无特征值信号的整体分岔，为从一组训练网络中读出物理结构提供了可解释工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络权重日益被当作数据对待，但缺乏“一组模型应编码什么”的真值，导致权重空间方法的系统验证困难；参数化动力系统在参数流形子集上发生性质变化的临界点已知（解析或数值），因而可作为天然测试床。

Method: 在参数网格每点微调预测网络，构建以物理参数为索引的model zoo（四个动力系统）；用JEPAWG（联合嵌入超网络，学习参数—权重表示，最初用于格点场论神经采样器）对其分析；以解码权重的参数导数范数为诊断量，检验分岔识别能力，并与直接为预测训练的超网络比较预测性能。

Result: 尽管JEPAWG仅以参数—权重对应关系为监督而非预测任务，其在预测上仍与直接训练的超网络具竞争力；参数导数范数可定位Hopf点及曲线，紧密跟踪倍周期级联并给出Feigenbaum常数的定性估计，还能检测无特征值特征、线性化不可见的整体分岔。

Conclusion: JEPAWG可提供其他超网络不具备的可解释动力学洞见，是“从训练网络群体中读取物理结构”的可行工具；同时model zoo范式为权重空间方法提供了带真值的系统验证框架。

Abstract: Trained network weights are increasingly treated as data, but there is rarely ground truth about what a population of models should encode, which hampers systematic validation of weight-space methods. This makes parametric dynamical systems a natural test-bed: the dynamics change qualitatively at submanifolds of parameter space that are, in well-studied families, known analytically or numerically. Fine-tuning a forecasting network at each point of a parameter grid yields a model zoo indexed by a physical parameter, against which weight-space diagnostics can be checked.
  We build such model zoos for four dynamical systems and analyse them with JEPAWG, a recently proposed joint-embedding hypernetwork built around a learned parameter--weight representation. It was first introduced for neural samplers for lattice field theories, where its latent geometry located the phase transition and estimated the 2D Ising critical exponent. Applied to dynamical systems, JEPAWG is competitive on forecasting with a hypernetwork trained directly for that task, despite being supervised on the parameter--weight correspondence rather than on forecasts. Beyond forecasting, the norm of the parameter-derivative of the decoded weights locates Hopf points and curves, tracks a period-doubling cascade closely enough to give a qualitative estimate of the Feigenbaum constant, and detects a global bifurcation, which has no eigenvalue signature and is therefore invisible to linearisation. As such, JEPAWG provides interpretable insight into the dynamics that is not available from other hypernetworks. Together, these results indicate that JEPAWG is a workable instrument for reading physical structure off a population of trained networks.

</details>


### [380] [Training Mixed-Monotone Neural Networks for Verification Without Set Propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30853)
*Jonas Fingerhut,Lukas Koller,Matthias Althoff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种可实现混合单调函数（作为单调子网络之差）的新型网络架构，把紧输出包络的计算简化为两次前向传播，并可在训练中直接最小化包络大小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络形式验证通常需要保守地包络输出集合，但计算紧输出包络在一般情况下计算困难，现有方法（CROWN、α-CROWN、zonotope传播等）速度慢或不够紧。

Method: 设计将混合单调函数表示为两个单调子网络之差的架构；利用混合单调系统理论，用输入区间两个相反角点的两次前向传播得到紧输出包络；包络大小是权重的闭式函数，故可在训练中直接最小化；并证明关于包络大小的下界（推广到多输入的total variation），用于与最优值比较。

Result: 在回归与动力系统基准上，训练使包络大小降至下界的0.5%以内且不损失预测精度；包络计算比CROWN和α-CROWN快数个数量级；在深层网络上比zonotope传播和CROWN更紧，大小仅比α-CROWN大5.1%。

Conclusion: 通过架构设计将难的集合传播问题转化为两次前向传播，兼顾紧性、速度与可训练性，为神经网络形式验证提供高效的输出包络方案。

Abstract: Most formal verification approaches for neural networks conservatively enclose the output set of the neural network. However, computing a tight output enclosure is in general computationally hard. We sidestep this challenge with a novel neural network architecture that realizes mixed-monotone functions as the difference of monotone subnetworks. By utilizing the theory on mixed-monotone systems, this reduces the computation of a tight output enclosure from complicated set propagation to two simple forward passes of opposite corners of an input interval. Moreover, because the size of the resulting enclosure is a closed-form function of the weights of the neural network, we can directly minimize it during training. We prove a lower bound on the size of any such enclosure, given by the total variation of the represented function generalized to several inputs, which makes it possible to compare the tightness of the enclosure against the optimum. Our evaluation on regression and dynamical-system benchmarks demonstrates that our training reduces the enclosure size to within 0.5% of the lower bound without sacrificing prediction accuracy. Computing our enclosure is orders of magnitude faster than CROWN and $α$-CROWN and on deep networks it is also tighter than zonotope propagation and CROWN, while its size exceeds that of $α$-CROWN by only 5.1%.

</details>


### [381] [Joules-to-GDP: How Much Economic Value Do AI Systems Produce per Unit of Energy?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30858)
*Amirreza Zeinali,Jon Saad-Falcon,Avanika Narayan,Mersad Abbasi,Jonathan S. Hartley,John Hennessy,Christopher Re,Azalia Mirhoseini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出以"每焦耳净价值（NVJ, USD/MJ）"和"每焦耳节省时间（TSJ, hours/MJ）"量化AI系统单位能耗的经济回报，并在220个GDPval任务、44种职业、5个开源权重模型与4类加速器上实证，发现经济回报每焦耳与绝对产出价值、成功率的排序并不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统能产出更具经济价值的工作，但其所耗能量带来的价值回报尚不明确。现有评测多关注任务成功率或输出价值，缺乏将经济价值与端到端能耗统一度量的框架，因而无法回答"单位能量创造多少经济价值"这一问题。

Method: 将经济价值形式化为两类指标：(1) 净美元价值=产出美元价值−AI系统执行成本；(2) 时间节省=专家完成时间−AI完成时间。两者分别除以实测端到端能耗，得到NVJ（USD/MJ）与TSJ（hours/MJ）。实验覆盖220个公开GDPval任务、44种职业，本地部署5个开源权重模型，并评测4类加速器。

Result: (1) 成功率最高、美元价值最大或节省时间最多的职业组，未必每焦耳经济回报最高：工程类比软件开发每任务净美元价值高约10%，但软件开发的NVJ高约27%。(2) GLM 5.2平均净美元价值最高，为每任务$72.27、耗能0.430 MJ（约相当于4小时笔记本活跃使用）；Gemma 4 31B仅以23%的能量获得其56%的净美元价值，NVJ约为2.5倍、TSJ约为2.8倍。(3) 四种单加速器部署下，Qwen3.6-27B的NVJ相差4.32倍、TSJ相差9.27倍，B200均居首。(4) 1块与8块H100净美元价值相近，但8块将完成时间缩短22%，能耗为3.24倍。

Conclusion: 该框架将"能量预算下的产出价值与专家时间节省"明确为改进模型、加速器与软件的目标函数，为评估AI对职业工作的潜在经济影响提供了新基准。

Abstract: An AI system can produce more economically valuable work while delivering less value for the energy it consumes. We therefore ask: How much economic value does an AI system create per unit of energy consumed? We formalize economic value in two ways: (1) net dollar value, the output's dollar value minus AI-system execution cost, and (2) time saving, the expert's completion time minus the AI system's completion time. Dividing each by measured end-to-end energy yields Net Value per Joule (NVJ) and Time Saving per Joule (TSJ), reported in USD/MJ and hours/MJ. We study 220 public GDPval tasks across 44 occupations, serving five open-weight models locally and evaluating four accelerator types. First, the occupation groups where AI systems succeed most often, deliver the greatest dollar value, or save the most time do not necessarily provide the greatest economic return per joule. For example, among the tested tasks, engineering work delivers about 10% more net dollar value per task than software development. Yet software development delivers about 27% more net value per joule. Second, GLM 5.2 delivers the highest average net dollar value, at $72.27 per task using 0.430 MJ, equivalent in energy to about four hours of active laptop use. By contrast, Gemma 4 31B delivers 56% of that net dollar value using just 23% of the energy, achieving approximately 2.5 times the NVJ and 2.8 times the TSJ. Third, across four single-accelerator deployments, Qwen3.6-27B's NVJ varies by a factor of 4.32 and TSJ by 9.27, with B200 leading both. Additionally, one and eight H100s deliver similar net dollar value, but eight reduce completion time by 22% at 3.24 times the energy. Our framework makes output value and expert time saving under an energy budget explicit objectives for improving models, accelerators, and software, while offering a new basis for assessing AI's potential economic effect on occupational work.

</details>


### [382] [MOER: Mix-Policy Optimization under Expert Prefix Guidance with Selective Rollback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30873)
*Xuyang Zhong,Jiuding Yang,Yiwen Guo,Chen Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MOER混合策略优化框架，通过衰减式专家思维链前缀注入与选择性回滚机制，调和专家引导与自主探索，并配合协调的混合策略目标稳定训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合策略优化方法存在问题：静态全轨迹引导会压制自探索，而专家前缀引导缺乏正确性保证，导致性能次优甚至训练崩溃。因此需要一种能协调专家引导与自主探索且保证离策略轨迹正确性的方法。

Method: MOER包含三部分：(1) 向提示中注入衰减的专家思维链前缀，由模型补全剩余推理，前缀长度逐步退火以鼓励自探索；(2) 选择性回滚机制，将失败补全替换为原始完整专家轨迹，确保每条离策略轨迹正确；(3) 协调的混合策略目标，对在策略token使用GRPO损失，对专家前缀与补全token使用信赖域SFT损失。

Result: 在数学与通用领域推理任务上取得最高平均分，优于所有基础与混合策略基线，并在多样任务、模型规模与基座模型类别上保持一致的泛化性。

Conclusion: MOER通过前缀退火、选择性回滚与混合目标设计，有效平衡专家引导与自主探索并保证轨迹正确性，稳定训练并显著提升推理性能。

Abstract: Mix-policy optimization incorporates off-policy expert data into the reinforcement learning (RL) loop to transcend the capability boundary of on-policy RL. However, existing methods either provide static full-trace guidance that suppresses self-exploration, or adopt expert prefix guidance without correctness guarantees, leading to suboptimal performance or even training collapse. In this paper, we propose MOER, a mix-policy optimization framework that harmonizes expert guidance with self-exploration. MOER injects a decaying expert chain-of-thought prefix into the prompt and lets the model complete the remaining reasoning, with the prefix length progressively annealed to encourage self-exploration. A selective rollback mechanism replaces failed completions with the original full expert trace, guaranteeing the correctness of every off-policy trajectory. Furthermore, a harmonized mix-policy objective optimizes on-policy tokens with a GRPO loss while supervising both expert prefix and completion tokens with a trust-region SFT loss, substantially stabilizing training. Extensive experiments show that MOER achieves the highest average scores in mathematical and general domain reasoning tasks, outperforming all basic and mix-policy baselines, and generalizes consistently across diverse tasks, model scales, and base model categories. Codes are available at https://github.com/CityU-MLO/MOER.

</details>


### [383] [One Teacher, Many Views: Reducing Reference Sensitivity in On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30880)
*Khouloud Saadi,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出现有on-policy自蒸馏(OPSD)中"以完整参考解为条件的单一教师分布"存在reference-induced target instability问题，提出Monte Carlo Privileged Distillation (MCPD)：将特权上下文建模为部分参考视图上的分布并蒸馏边际教师分布，在数学与科学推理基准上持续优于完整参考OPSD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPSD通过特权教师（以完整参考解为条件）对学生自身轨迹进行token级密集监督以提升推理能力。但作者指出其局限：参考解只是推理过程的一种实现，除答案证据外还编码了特定顺序、措辞与解题路径；以完整参考为条件会产生依赖推理时学生不可得信息的"正确"目标。实验显示，在题目与学生状态固定时替换另一个同样有效的参考解，会显著改变教师分布，即reference-induced target instability。

Method: 提出MCPD：把特权上下文视为部分参考视图上的分布，在多个视图下评估教师，并对各视图的下一token分布取平均，从而蒸馏边际教师分布；作者论证该概率空间平均恰为在特权视图上最小化期望teacher-to-student KL散度所诱导的精确目标。

Result: 在数学与科学推理基准上，MCPD产生与参考更一致的监督信号，并一致优于full-reference OPSD。

Conclusion: 以单一完整参考为条件的教师目标不稳定且含不可得信息，将特权上下文边际化为部分视图上的分布并蒸馏其期望KL目标（即分布平均），可获得更稳定、更一致的监督并提升推理性能。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a model on its own trajectories with dense token-level supervision from a privileged copy conditioned on a reference solution. Existing methods typically use a single teacher distribution conditioned on the complete reference. We identify a limitation of this formulation: a reference is only one realization of the reasoning process. Although it provides evidence about the answer, it also encodes an ordering, phrasing, and solution path. Full-reference conditioning can therefore produce correct targets that depend excessively on information unavailable to the student at inference. We show that replacing one valid reference with another, while holding the problem and student state fixed, can substantially alter the teacher distribution, a phenomenon we call reference-induced target instability. To address this instability, we introduce Monte Carlo Privileged Distillation (MCPD), which models privileged context as a distribution over partial reference views and distills the marginal teacher distribution. MCPD evaluates the teacher under multiple views and averages the resulting next-token distributions. We show that this probability-space average is the exact target induced by minimizing the expected teacher-to-student KL divergence over privileged views. Across mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks, we show that MCPD produces more reference-consistent supervision and consistently improves over full-reference OPSD.

</details>


### [384] [Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30882)
*Zhizhuo Kou,Sizai Hou,Long Chen,Jian Yang,Junyu Luo,Jingshu Peng,Wenkai Zhang,Sirui Han,Yike Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 文章追踪推理模型中"wait"一词的来源，指出该标记主要由训练数据（中训练/推理轨迹微调）注入而非RL新创；RL准确率提升并不依赖该词。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流观点认为RL教会了推理模型在重新考虑某一步之前先输出"wait"，从而把RL"发现"的能力与模型从训练数据中"继承"的模式混为一谈；作者希望厘清这一因果归因。

Method: 沿开放模型的训练史追踪"wait"：用无标签指标（频率、位置、形式、用法）及注入错误测试，全部基于采样输出计算；对比零RL、中训练(OLMo-3)、推理轨迹微调、RL-Zero配方(OLMo-3、MiMo)、无KL的GRPO、SFT后RL等多种设置。

Result: 零RL几乎从不创造该标记：在缺少该词的基础模型上，RL显著提升MATH-500准确率而"wait"仍近乎缺失；它随训练数据出现——OLMo-3中训练阶段产生，推理轨迹微调可将其装入多数原本缺失的模型；基础模型已具备时，两套已发布RL-Zero配方(OLMo-3、MiMo)会使其倍增，而同基座的无KL GRPO不会；OLMo-3配方削弱其形式并使其成为更敏感但更宽松的警报；SFT后的RL几乎不改变它，作者的GRPO配方反而抹去微调植入的标记。

Conclusion: 标记频率本身不能指示RL诱导的推理能力，应警惕以LLM-as-a-judge作为修订指标——自动评判器可能逆转人工标注的趋势。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is credited with teaching reasoning models to write {wait} before reconsidering a step, yet large RL accuracy gains do not require the word. This view can confuse what RL discovers with what a model inherits from its training data. We trace the word through open models' training histories, reading it with label-free indices of frequency, position, form and usage and an injected-error test, all computed from sampled outputs. We find that zero-RL almost never coins the marker: on bases that lack the word, RL raises MATH-500 accuracy substantially while {wait} stays near absent. It arrives with training data: mid-training in OLMo-3, and fine-tuning on reasoning traces installs it in most models whose base lacks it. Where the base already uses it, both released RL-Zero recipes (OLMo-3, MiMo) multiply it, whereas KL-free GRPO from the same base does not; OLMo-3's recipe wears down its form and makes it a more sensitive but more liberal alarm; RL after supervised fine-tuning barely changes it, and our GRPO recipe erases a marker seeded by fine-tuning. Finally, we show that marker frequency alone does not indicate RL-induced reasoning and caution against LLM-as-a-judge revision metrics, as automated judges can reverse human-labelled trends.

</details>


### [385] [Tracing Subliminal Learning Through Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30884)
*Angela Tang,Vishesh Anand,Gonçalo Paulo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究"阈下学习"（subliminal learning）：基于其他模型生成数据训练的LLM会继承与数据无关的偏好特征。作者在硬标签蒸馏和on-policy软标签蒸馏两种设定下系统性验证该现象的普遍性，并探究偏好信号的载体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前模型训练（尤其后训练）大量使用模型生成数据和蒸馏，已有工作暗示学生模型可能继承与训练数据内容无关的"阈下"特质，但该现象在不同设定下的稳健性、迁移的对称性及信号载体尚不清楚，直接关系到蒸馏的安全性。

Method: 采用Pythia、PolyPythia与DataDecide OLMo模型，在硬标签蒸馏（学生拟合有偏教师生成的数字标签）与on-policy软标签蒸馏（学生自生成数据，教师logits作监督信号）两种设定下，跨权重初始化、预训练数据顺序、预训练语料、模型规模与架构检验迁移；跨预训练checkpoint比较"教师能力"与"学生能力"；反转师生角色评估迁移对称性；构造匹配教师生成数字频率但与提示/前序数字无关的合成数字序列定位信号载体；并在top-K软标签蒸馏中剔除动物token检验损失项贡献。

Result: ①两种设定下迁移均持续存在，且对权重初始化、数据顺序、语料、模型规模、架构的差异稳健；②跨checkpoint看，传递偏好与习得偏好的能力相互独立发展，有些checkpoint更擅长当教师而非学生，反之亦然；③师生角色反转时迁移幅度呈强不对称；④与提示无关、仅匹配教师数字频率的合成序列在硬标签设定下仍产生显著迁移；⑤top-K软标签蒸馏中剔除动物token可减弱但不完全消除同模型情形下的迁移；⑥软标签蒸馏在更少训练量下即可产生更一致的迁移。

Conclusion: 阈下偏好迁移是跨模型、跨训练配置稳健存在的现象；"传递"与"习得"是两种可分离的能力，迁移具有不对称性；部分信号可由与语义上下文无关的简单统计结构（数字频率）承载，但难以被完全消除。鉴于on-policy蒸馏在后训练中日益普及，该现象构成需要重点评估的非预期偏好传递风险。

Abstract: Large language models trained on data generated by other models can sometimes inherit traits unrelated to that data, a phenomenon called subliminal learning. We study both hard label distillation, where students train on numbers generated by a biased teacher, and on-policy soft label distillation, where students generate the data and the teacher's logits provide the learning signal. Using Pythia, PolyPythia, and DataDecide OLMo models, we find that transfer persists in both settings across differences in weight initialization, pretraining data order, pretraining corpus, model size, and architecture. Across pretraining checkpoints, the ability to transmit a preference and the ability to acquire one develop separately: some checkpoints are more effective teachers but weaker students, and vice versa. Consistent with this distinction, cross-model transfer can be strongly asymmetric in magnitude when teacher and student roles are reversed. To investigate what carries the preference signal, we construct synthetic number sequences that match the teacher's generated number frequencies but have no dependence on the prompt or preceding numbers and find that these still induce substantial transfer in the hard-label setting. In top-$K$ soft-label distillation, removing animal tokens from the loss reduces transfer, although not completely in the same-model setting. In our experiments, soft label distillation produces more consistent transfer with less extensive training than hard label distillation. The growing use of on-policy distillation in model post-training makes this a particularly relevant setting for assessing unintended preference transfer.

</details>


### [386] [Building Presentation Intelligence for High-Quality Slide Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30888)
*Yuhang Xie,Cheng Li,Chenliang Li,Mingyu Xu,Mingwei Sun,Suhang Zheng,Ming Yan,Xiaoxiao Xu,Lin Qu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向"演示智能"的自动PPT生成统一训练框架，整合交叉验证式数据合成、规则与先验知识引导的教师增强，以及基于GRPO的可验证奖励优化；增强后的SFT使Qwen-3.6-27B与Qwen-3.6-35B-A3B在PresentBench上分别提升7.45与9.35分并超过GLM-5.2，强化学习进一步在五个美学维度上补偿SFT的视觉精修短板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PPT是跨领域主流沟通媒介，但高质量PPT生成仍高度依赖人工投入；LLM智能体能力的发展为自动化PPT生成带来新机遇与挑战，现有方法在数据质量、教师指导能力与视觉美学监督方面存在不足。

Method: (1) 构建可显式控制难度与有效性的交叉验证式数据合成流水线；(2) 提出基于规则与先验知识的教师增强框架以提升教师模型的教学能力；(3) 采用混合教师策略与轻量级结果驱动轨迹过滤改进SFT；(4) 在SFT模型基础上引入一套可验证美学指标与基于GRPO的强化学习框架，优化幻灯片级视觉属性以突破纯文本监督。

Result: 增强SFT流水线使Qwen-3.6-27B和Qwen-3.6-35B-A3B在PresentBench上分别提升7.45分和9.35分，超越GLM-5.2并保持较强泛化性；强化学习在五个美学维度上进一步提升性能，弥补SFT在视觉精修上的局限。

Conclusion: 实验结果验证了该统一训练框架对高质量PPT生成的有效性，数据合成、教师增强、混合教师SFT与可验证奖励RL的组合可系统性提升演示文稿生成的文本与视觉质量。

Abstract: PowerPoint presentations (PPTs) are a dominant medium for communication across diverse domains, yet high-quality PPT generation still depends heavily on labor-intensive human effort. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) for agentic tasks have created both new opportunities and challenges (Chen et al., 2026) for automatic PPT generation. In this work, we present a unified training framework for automatic PPT generation toward presentation intelligence, integrating cross-validated data synthesis, guided teacher enhancement, and verifiable reward optimization. We first construct a cross-validated pipeline for data synthesis, with explicit control over both difficulty and validity. We then develop a teacher-enhancement framework grounded in rules and prior knowledge to substantially strengthen the instructional capacity of teacher models. Building on this, we further improve supervised fine-tuning (SFT) through a mixed-teacher strategy and a lightweight outcome-driven trajectory filtering method. Finally, based on the resulting SFT models, we introduce a suite of verifiable aesthetic metrics together with a GRPO-based reinforcement learning framework to optimize slide-level visual attributes beyond text-only supervision. Experiments show that our enhanced SFT pipeline improves Qwen-3.6-27B and Qwen-3.6-35B-A3B by 7.45 and 9.35 points on PresentBench, respectively, surpassing GLM-5.2 while maintaining strong generalization. Reinforcement learning further improves performance across five aesthetic dimensions, compensating for the limitations of SFT in visual refinement. Overall, the results demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework for high-quality PPT generation.

</details>


### [387] [Same molecule, Different Knowledge: Cross-Identifier Binding Failures in LLMs For chemistry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30903)
*Khouloud Saadi,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文揭示同一分子的不同标识符（俗名、IUPAC名、SMILES）在LLM中并非可互换的知识入口，提出"跨标识符绑定失败"现象，并提出Binding Self-Distillation缓解方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化学AI工作流通常假设同一分子的多种指称（trivial name、IUPAC名、SMILES）可互换地访问LLM知识，但该假设缺乏检验，可能导致知识检索的隐性失败。

Method: 构建受控基准测试，覆盖7B–72B多种基座及化学专用模型；开展行为、表征与因果三类受控分析，考察内部表示、冲突标识符与参数编辑；据此提出Binding Self-Distillation，利用训练中的词汇身份将模型已有知识访问迁移到结构路线（SMILES）。

Result: 在所有测试模型中，同指分子标识符一致地暴露模型知识的不同子集；模型可由SMILES识别分子、并经名称检索到某事实，但同一事实无法直接从SMILES获取；提升化学表示能力或编辑单条事实均不足以建立可靠的跨标识符访问。

Conclusion: 核心失败在于标识符与模型已有知识之间的绑定，而非表示能力或事实存储本身；Binding Self-Distillation可在推理时直接从SMILES进行事实检索，无需名称查找或从头训练模型。

Abstract: Chemical AI workflows routinely represent the same molecule through multiple co-referring identifiers, including trivial names, IUPAC names, and SMILES, implicitly assuming that these representations provide interchangeable access to an LLM's knowledge. To test this assumption, we first introduce a controlled benchmark and show that it does not hold. Across foundation models spanning 7B to 72B parameters, even chemistry-specialized models, co-referring molecular identifiers consistently expose different subsets of the model's knowledge. We then conduct a series of controlled behavioral, representational, and causal analyses to characterize this failure. We show that even when a model can identify a molecule from its SMILES and retrieve a fact through the corresponding name, the same fact can remain inaccessible directly from SMILES. We term this phenomenon \emph{cross-identifier binding failure}. Further analysis of internal representations, conflicting identifiers, and parameter editing shows that neither improved chemical representation competence nor modification of individual facts is sufficient to establish reliable access across identifiers. Together, these results indicate that the core failure lies in the binding between an identifier and knowledge already present in the model. Motivated by this diagnosis, we introduce Binding Self-Distillation, a simple mitigation that uses lexical identity during training to transfer the model's existing knowledge access to the structural route. This enables factual retrieval directly from SMILES at inference time, without requiring a name lookup or training the underlying model from scratch.

</details>


### [388] [Random Initialization as a Baseline for Time Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30950)
*Pinar Sungu Isiacik,Georgiana Ifrim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在UEA MTSC档案上对比7个公开TSFM实例与其同架构随机初始化版本，冻结表征下预训练权重带来的平均精度提升仅2.58个百分点，且Holm校正后仅NuTime显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MTSC评估常将TSFM的性能增益笼统归因于自监督预训练，但未区分"预训练权重"与"底层架构"各自的贡献，也缺少与强非预训练基线的对照。

Method: 选取4个TSFM家族共7个公开权重实例，构建架构匹配的随机初始化对照；每个实例用5次随机初始化、4种冻结表征分类器（ridge、逻辑回归、RBF SVM、随机森林）评估；剔除计算受限项后得到183组数据集级配对比较；采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验（Holm校正）为主、跨全部配对池化检验为辅，并与ROCKET、Hydra、Quant对比。

Result: 预训练对全部7个实例均提升平均精度，但幅度有限（1.43–5.19个百分点，均值2.58）；7个逐实例检验中3个原始p<0.05，Holm校正后仅NuTime显著；183组池化检验p<0.001；ROCKET、Hydra、Quant无需大规模预训练仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: MTSC评估应分离预训练权重效应与架构效应，并同时纳入架构匹配随机初始化对照与强非预训练基线；预训练带来的收益相对架构本身较为有限。

Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) use self-supervised pretraining to learn reusable representations for downstream tasks such as multivariate time series classification (MTSC). We examine how much pretrained weights contribute beyond the architecture itself by comparing seven publicly released instances from four TSFM families with architecture-matched randomly initialized counterparts on the UEA MTSC archive. For each instance, five random initializations are evaluated using four classifiers on frozen representations: ridge classification, logistic regression, RBF SVM, and random forest. After model-specific exclusions due to computational constraints, the study comprises 183 paired dataset-level comparisons. Pretraining improves mean accuracy for all seven instances, but the gains are modest, ranging from 1.43 to 5.19 percentage points, with an overall average improvement of 2.58 points. Three of seven per-instance Wilcoxon signed-rank tests have raw $p$-values below 0.05, but only NuTime remains significant after Holm correction. A secondary pooled test across all 183 pairs gives $p < 0.001$, while the corrected per-instance tests remain the primary evidence. We also compare with ROCKET, Hydra, and Quant, which remain competitive without requiring large-scale pretraining.
